ranged.description:
A regular enemy's attack at range (core Z2): the run holds one of the
`MAX_RANGED_ATTACKERS` tokens while it winds up and is active, and a start that would
exceed the cap waits for the next tick with its cooldown still ready. Not valid on a
companion, an elite or the boss.

Agent.description: A companion, a regular enemy or (inside a boss phase) the boss: a movement and a rule list.

defence.description: Reduces every hit it takes to `K / (K + defence)` of it; 0 when absent.

elite.description:
An enemy that holds where it spawned and acts only while the main character is within
its range, until a boss calls it; its star is a tier higher. Not a companion.

poise.description:
A regular enemy's or an elite's poise: a combo hit of a main character that deals at
least this much poise damage makes it flinch (`flinch_ticks` of the rules). 0 to
`limits::MAX_POISE` (1,000); `sim_version` 2 only, and the rules must name `flinch_ticks`.
Absent: it never flinches.

profile.description:
What it is weak and strong against; without one, every type is neutral against
it. An enemy's or an elite's only: a companion has none.

rules.description: Evaluated in order each tick; the first rule that can fire, fires (ADR-SIM-4).

stagger_max.description:
An elite's stagger gauge: a main character's smash and a control it resists fill it, and a
full gauge staggers the elite (`staggered_ticks`, else the rules'). 1 to
`limits::MAX_STAGGER` (10,000); `sim_version` 2 only; an elite's only. Absent: no gauge.

staggered_ticks.description:
Ticks a staggered elite stays staggered: 1 to `limits::MAX_STAGGERED_TICKS` (600). Only
with `stagger_max`. Absent: the rules' `staggered_ticks`.

threat_colour.description:
Names an entry of the pack's threat colour table (ADR-CONT-1, ADR-BRDG-4): the colour of
this enemy's attack areas. Which entry exists is checked where the table is known (pack
load, run build); the validator holds the shape. `sim_version` 2 only; an enemy's or the
boss's, never a companion's.

Anchor.description: Where a hit box or a zone is anchored (core Z1).

oneOf.description:
The attacker's own spot: a hit box follows its attacker, a zone stays where the attacker
was when the zone was placed.

The target's spot: where the target stood when the attack began, so that a target that
leaves during the wind-up leaves the area too.

name.description: What the argument is, unique within its preset: lowercase snake_case.

advance.description:
A phase of the main character's combo step (attack magnetism): the player slides along the
facing the step took toward the assist's target over the phase, this far in all (1/256 px, 1 px to `limits::MAX_ADVANCE_DISTANCE`). Absent:
no slide. Read at `sim_version` 2, for a combo step only (ADR-CONT-3).

breaks_charge.description:
A powerful attack: its hits on the main character, by hit box or by the zones the phase
spawns, break a charge in progress (core#83).

counterable.description:
A `wind_up` phase of an enemy's or the boss's attack only: a smash step of the main
character's whose hit box hits the attacker while the phase runs counters it (cancels the
attack, stuns a regular enemy or an elite, staggers an elite or the boss). `sim_version` 2
only; absent or false: the phase cannot be countered.

damage.description:
Base damage of the phase's hits and of the zones it spawns. Absent, it is
what the attacker's own attack does: the main character's `atk`, a `shot` skill's
`damage`, or 100 (1 at the design values) for an enemy or the boss.

dash.description:
An active phase of an enemy's or the boss's attack only: the attacker moves along the
attack's locked facing over the phase, hit box and boss parts with it (DS11).

hit_box.description: The area the phase covers, attached to the attacker.

move_pct.description: The attacker's movement speed during the phase, in percent; 0 roots it.

poise_damage.description:
An active phase with a hit box of a main character's or an ally's attack only: the poise
damage of its combo hits, 0 to `limits::MAX_POISE_DAMAGE` (1,000); `sim_version` 2 only.
Absent: the rules' `poise_damage_a` or `poise_damage_b` by the press.

rehit_ticks.description: An active phase only: a target already hit may be hit again after this many ticks.

spawn.description:
Emitter nodes started on the phase's first tick, carried out in order (see `sim`'s
attacks for what each one does).

stagger.description:
The same kind of phase only: the stagger its combo hits add to the gauge of an elite or the
boss, 0 to `limits::MAX_STAGGER` (10,000); `sim_version` 2 only. Absent: the rules'
`stagger_smash` for a smash step, 0 for any other.

ticks.description:
How long the phase lasts: a constant, never an expression, so that an attack's length
and its telegraph are known before it runs.

type.description:
The damage type of the phase's hits and of the zones it spawns; absent, they
are neutral and never get a match-up.

args.description: The arguments in order: as many as the registry says the preset takes.

id.description: A registered preset ID, unique within the file.

phases.description: The attack, with its arguments still as `arg` nodes.

presets.description: The presets, 1 to `MAX_ATTACK_PRESETS`; every registered preset is among them.

AttackRef.description:
A preset by ID with its arguments, or an inline definition. A preset's arguments are bounded by
its registry entry.

oneOf.description: The phases, in order.

AttackView.description:
An attack in progress, for the frontend to draw its telegraph and its swing on the
same tick that `core` judges them.

at.description:
Where its hit box is centred, offset along `facing`, when that is not its attacker: an
on-hit rune's attack, at the point the combo step hit.

counterable.description:
The run's current phase is a `counterable` wind-up: the frontend marks the attack as one a
smash counters. Derived each tick, not state; absent is the key missing from the JSON.

facing.description:
The facing locked when the attack started; an orbit's orb's turns every tick, and its hit
box with it.

preset.description: The preset it came from; absent for an inline attack.

slot.description: 0 for an agent's or the boss's attacks and the main character's combo.

threat_colour.description:
The entry of the run's threat colour table (`Engine::threat_colours`) the enemy that
made it names; absent for every other area, and for an enemy that names none: the
frontend draws its own hostile colour. Never present on a friendly area. Absent is the
key missing from the JSON.

tick.description: Ticks done in the phase: 0 on its first tick.

Aura.description:
What a pack leader does for the enemies near it. Every non-elite enemy whose centre
is within `radius` of the leader's centre (the edge counts) deals its damage times
`100 + damage_percent` over 100, rounded down; when several leaders reach it, the highest
`damage_percent` counts. It ends with the leader's death.

Blanket.description: A blanket resist: every attack type, or every element.

Boss.description: Tier 2 (ADR-SIM-4): body parts and an ordered list of phases that only move forward.

arrives_at_tick.description:
The tick the boss comes onto the field: its first tick is this one. Absent or 1, it is
there from the first tick. Needs `sim_version` 2, and a tick before the stage's `length_ticks`.
(A `time_limit` run's bosses come at the mode file's `boss_ticks`, not at this.)

call_elites.description: When every elite alive joins the boss fight; without it the boss calls none.

chase.description:
The boss walks toward the player its attacks aim at, until it is `stop_distance` from
them; without it the boss stays where its timeline and rules put it. Needs
`sim_version` 2.

defence.description: Reduces every hit it takes to `K / (K + defence)` of it; 0 when absent.

expertise.description: The expertise points the boss gives; none when absent.

profile.description:
What it is weak and strong against; without one, every type is neutral against
it.

radius.description: A length in 1/256 pixel units. In files it is the plain integer.

staggered_ticks.description:
Ticks the boss stays staggered: 1 to `limits::MAX_STAGGERED_TICKS` (600). Only with
`stagger_max`. Absent: the rules' `staggered_ticks`.

stardust.description: The Stardust its kill earns before the time factor, times 10; as a wave's `stardust`.

threat_colour.description:
Names an entry of the pack's threat colour table (ADR-CONT-1, ADR-BRDG-4): the colour of
this enemy's attack areas. Which entry exists is checked where the table is known (pack
load, run build); the validator holds the shape. `sim_version` 2 only; an enemy's or the
boss's, never a companion's.

BossCall.description: What a boss's call does to an elite.

oneOf.description: It is called: it leaves its place and fights beside the boss.
It is not called: it leaves the map instead, unkilled and with no reward.
It is not called and does not leave: it stays where it is (the shrine's).

BossPart.description: A breakable part with its own HP and hurt circle (ADR-CONT-7, ADR-SIM-4).

asset.description: Asset ID of the part's sprite.

defence.description: Reduces every hit it takes to `K / (K + defence)` of it; 0 when absent.

id.description: Unique within the boss; `part_broken` and the `part` selector use it.

profile.description: Its own profile, not the boss's; without one, every type is neutral against it.

radius.description: A length in 1/256 pixel units. In files it is the plain integer.

Branches.description: The steps that follow: at most one for a press of each button.

main.description: The step a press of `main` (A) takes.

smash.description: The step a press of `smash` (B) takes: a smash, which the weapon's smash effect joins.

CallElites.description:
The boss calls its elites at whichever comes first: `after_ticks` ticks after its first
tick (0 calls on it), or its hit points falling below `below_pct` percent of its maximum.
At least one of the two is given.

CarriedStar.description: A star the run starts holding: a reward of the run's rewards file.

ChannelFile.description: One channel as it sits in the file.

pack_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the pack's bytes: 64 lowercase hex digits.

tag.description: The release tag of the pack, such as `v0.2.0`.

text_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the pack's text content: 64 lowercase hex digits, or null until it is made.

url.description: Where the pack downloads from: `https://`, at most 512 bytes.

Charge.description:
A charged step: the ticks held raise its level, and letting go attacks at the
level reached; inside the level's perfect window it adds its perfect bonus. At `max_ticks`
it releases by itself, without the bonus. Level 0, before the first of `levels`, is the
step's own attack. The frontend slows time from level 1; the rules do not.

levels.description: Level 1 and up, in order of `at_ticks`, the first after 0.

move_pct.description: The main character's movement speed while charging, in percent; 100 when absent.

ChargeLevel.description: One level of a charge, from level 1.

at_ticks.description: Ticks held at which the level is reached.

perfect_attack.description: A perfect release makes this attack instead, with `perfect_pct` too.

perfect_pct.description: The perfect bonus: this much more damage, in percent, for every hit of the release.

perfect_ticks.description: The perfect window: the first `perfect_ticks` ticks of the level; 0 for none.

ChargeView.description:
A charge in progress. `core` judges the perfect window on this tick, so what the
frontend shows is what a release on the next tick gets.

held.description: Ticks held since the step began to charge, 0 on its first tick.

level.description:
The level reached: 0 before level 1, when letting go is a plain step and the frontend
keeps its clock at full speed.

perfect.description: Inside the level's perfect window: letting go on the next tick is a perfect release.

Chase.description:
How a boss chases (`Boss.chase`). Both defaults are placeholders: the tuning table is the
app's.

speed.description:
How far it walks a tick, in 1/256 pixel; below the players' speed, so it can be kited.
256 (1 pixel a tick) when absent.

stop_distance.description:
It stops this far from its target, centre to centre, at most the map's longer side.
24,576 (96 pixels) when absent.

ComboView.description:
Where the main character is in its combos: what the frontend's combo trail draws,
with the next possible presses read from the weapon's tree.

auto.description: The auto combo: the presses auto mode plays from the root.

buffered.description: The press waiting for the next step.

dash.description: The presses began in the dash branch (a dash-strike).

presses.description: The presses from the root to the current step; empty at the root.

window_left.description: Ticks left in which a press continues the combo, once a step has run out.

oneOf.description: Ticks since the agent spawned, or since the boss phase began.

The main character's centre is within `distance` of the agent's centre (the edge counts):
an exploder's burst (ADR-SIM-4).

distance.description: A length in 1/256 pixel units. In files it is the plain integer.

id.description: Unique within the file; lowercase snake_case, at most 32 characters.

members.description: Named stars of the rewards file, 2 to `MAX_MEMBERS`, each in no other set.

name.description: The name the frontend shows, 1 to `MAX_TITLE_CHARS` characters.

tiers.description: From the smallest threshold to the member count.

ConstellationTier.description: What a set gives once `threshold` of its members are held.

effects.description:
The effects the set has at this tier in all: the reward effect list, at most
`MAX_TIER_EFFECTS`.

threshold.description:
Members held, from 1 to the member count; ascending over the tiers, the last being the
member count.

ConstellationView.description: How far a set of named stars is (core#NS3).

id.description: Its ID in the run's constellations file.

needed.description: Members the next tier needs; the whole set once the top tier is reached.

tier.description: The tier reached, counted from 1; 0 before the first.

ConstellationsFile.description: The constellations file: the sets of named stars.

ContentId.description:
A content ID from the registry (ADR-CONT-2): asset, palette, part, preset, status or pattern.
Lowercase `snake_case`, at most 32 characters; the validator checks the format and that the
ID exists.

ContentId2.description:
A content ID from the registry (ADR-CONT-2): asset, palette, part, preset, status or pattern.
Lowercase `snake_case`, at most 32 characters; the validator checks the format and that the
ID exists.

Countdown.description: A count-down in the snapshot: the ticks left and the ticks it started with.

DamageOverTimeRune.description:
A damage-over-time rune's numbers: the status a combo step's hit puts on
the enemy hit.

damage.description: The base damage of a tick for each stack, 1 to `MAX_DAMAGE`.

duration_ticks.description: Ticks it lasts after it was last applied, 1 to `MAX_DOT_DURATION_TICKS`.

interval_ticks.description:
Ticks between two of its damage ticks, 1 to `MAX_DOT_INTERVAL_TICKS`, at most the
duration.

max_stacks.description: The most stacks it reaches, 1 to `MAX_DOT_STACKS`.

type.description: Its ticks' damage type; absent, they are neutral.

DamageOverTimeView.description: A damage-over-time status on an entity: bleed, poison or burn.

next_tick_in.description: Ticks until it next deals its damage, at least 1.

ticks_left.description: Ticks until it runs out, unless it is applied again.

DamageType.description:
The damage types, a closed list: three attack types, which are physical, and the
elements. A list for the prototype; changing it is a schema change.

Dash.description:
A phase that carries its attacker forward: it covers `distance` over the phase's ticks, held
to the map. The phase's `move_pct` is 0, so that the walk does not add to it.

distance.description: A length in 1/256 pixel units. In files it is the plain integer.

boss_ticks.description:
The mode's boss times in ticks, in place of its file's: rising, the last at
`length_ticks`, at most `time_limit::MAX_BOSS_TIMES`.

damage_pct.description:
Percent of the content's damage every attack of an enemy, elite or boss does, from 1 to
`MAX_PCT`.

hp_pct.description:
Percent of the content's hit points every enemy, elite and boss (and each boss part)
starts with, from 1 to `MAX_PCT` (100 for normal).

id.description: The difficulty's own ID, unique within the file.

length_ticks.description: The mode's run length in ticks, in place of its file's: with `boss_ticks`, or neither.

level_table.description: The expertise levels in place of the mode's.

opens_after.description:
Absent: open with no clear. Otherwise the ID of an earlier difficulty of this file: this
one opens, in a mode, once that one is cleared there.

rarity_max.description: The highest rarity its drops and offers may have; not below `rarity_min`.

rarity_min.description: The lowest rarity its drops and offers may have, over all six.

rune_shards.description:
The Rune Shards a clear of this difficulty pays (game design, Rewards), 0 to
`MAX_RUNE_SHARDS`. The simulation never reads it; the app credits it (ADR-SAVE-3).

stardust_tiers.description:
The Stardust time factor's tiers in place of the mode's: as the
mode file's `stardust_tiers`.

oneOf.description: At the target, turned by `offset`.
A fixed angle: 0 points down the screen, and positive angles turn toward the right.

Turned by `angle` from the parent's direction: straight down for an attack that a rule
started, the orb's own direction for the zones of its `burst`.

Turned by `step` from the previous orb's or zone's direction; not affected by the turns of
`rotate`, `ring` and `spread`.
`source` damaged `target`.

buffed_by.description:
The other player whose attack-up was on `player` when the hit landed. Left out when
there is none, when it is `player` itself, and at `sim_version` 1.

crit.description: The main character's hit was a critical hit (core#NS2b); left out when not.

damage_type.description:
The damage type the hit was dealt in, whatever its source: a weapon, a rune,
the stage skill, a burst or a damage-over-time tick; left out when neutral.

echo.description: The hit is an echo of an earlier one, a tick later; left out when not.

match_up.description: The match-up the hit got; left out when none.

player.description:
The player credited with the hit, by its entity number (0 to 2, as `Healed::target`
names one): the owner of the shot, or slot 0 for a companion's. Left out for a hit
on an ally and for the frozen rules of `sim_version` 1 (ADR-SIM-7).

repeat.description: The hit is a step's delayed repeat (a style's `repeat` kind); left out when not.

rune.description:
The rune that dealt the hit: the on-hit rune whose attack landed, or the
damage-over-time rune whose status ticked; left out for every other hit.

target_kind.description:
The kind of `target` (`EntityView::kind_index`), an index into the run's `KindTable`: left out for the main character and
for a mimic still in disguise.

oneOf.description:
A kill burst went off where an enemy fell: it damaged the enemies within `radius`
(1/256 pixel) of `at`. `depth` counts the links of the chain, from 1 for the burst of
a kill by the main character.
The main character was hit.
A party player reached 0 hit points and went down (ADR-SIM-7).
A downed player was revived by `reviver` (ADR-SIM-7).
A downed player's out timer expired (ADR-SIM-7).
`target` regained `amount` hit points.

source.description:
The player that gave the heal (its entity number); left out when a companion or an
enemy gave it, and at `sim_version` 1.

The player that applied it (its entity number); left out when a companion or an
enemy did, and at `sim_version` 1.

oneOf.description: `target`'s stun ran out; it is immune to a new one for the immunity ticks.

`target`'s flinch ran out, or a stun that landed on it ended it; it is immune to a new
flinch for the rules' `flinch_immune_ticks`.

`target`'s stagger ran out: its gauge fills again from empty, each later bar at its own
refill rate.
`target`'s knockdown ran out: the enemy acts again unless a stun still holds it.

A smash step of `player`'s hit `attacker` during a `counterable` wind-up and countered
it: the attack is cancelled. `attack` is the attack's preset, absent for an inline one.
The main character started an evade.
The main character used its stage skill, at `level`.
A press took a combo step: the step `depth` presses from the root.

The combo went back to the root: its window passed, an evade, a broken charge, or a press
with no next step.

A charged step was released at `level` (from 1; a release before level 1 is a plain step
and says nothing), `perfect` inside the level's perfect window.
A charge ended without an attack: an evade, or a hit from an attack that breaks charges.

A held step's hold was let go, or reached its `max_ticks`, after `ticks` ticks held; its
release attack follows.
A hold ended without a release: an evade, or a hit from an attack that breaks charges.
An agent's rule fired: `rule` is its index in the agent's (or boss phase's) list (ADR-SIM-4).
The boss entered phase `phase` (0-based).
An attack is announced `ticks` ahead.

class.description:
What died, as the snapshot classifies it (`EntityView::kind`), so a reader never
guesses it from earlier snapshots: not even for an elite that dies on its first tick.

killer.description:
The player whose hit took it to 0 hit points (its entity number, the first hit of
the tick's fixed order). Left out when no hit did (a shrine cleared), for an ally,
and at `sim_version` 1.

kind.description:
The kind of the victim (`EntityView::kind_index`), an index into the run's `KindTable`; left out for a mimic still in
disguise.

oneOf.description:
The main character reached `level` (ADR-REPL-5): a stat is raised by the run's priority,
or a stat offer is due (DS18).

A level-up raised the run stat `stat`, by the priority or by a choice: it now has
`spent` points (ADR-REPL-5, DS18).
A kill dropped the falling star `star` (ADR-REPL-5).
The main character took the star `star`; its offer opens at the end of the tick.
A regular kill dropped the heal pickup `pickup`.

The boss called its elites: the `elites` alive leave their places and fight beside it,
and every elite that comes later is called at once.

An elite minute of a `time_limit` run brought the elite `elite`, of the sprite `asset`
; for a mimic, the sprite it is disguised as. Not sent when the cap on elites
alive held it back.

kind.description: The elite's kind (`EntityView::kind_index`), an index into the run's `KindTable`; left out for a mimic, which is disguised.

oneOf.description:
The leash moved the enemy `entity` just outside the view, on the side opposite the view's centre, or on the
enemy's own side when that one is off the map, so the frontend snaps its body instead of interpolating across
the screen (EC2, DS80).
The elite `elite` left the map without dying: no kill, no reward.

The main character touched the shrine `elite`: its guardians appeared and its timer began
.

The main character came within the mimic `elite`'s reveal radius: it is no longer
disguised, takes damage and acts as a grade elite from now on. Sent once.

The main character's hit box broke the breakable orb of `owner` at `at`, and its burst did
not run (core Z2).

player.description: The player whose swing or full-gauge clear broke it; absent in a version 1 run.

oneOf.description:
The reward was taken: the run now has it `taken` times. For a random rune, `rune` is
the rune it drew, now on the Main weapon.

star.description: The star's name when the reward is a named star (core#NS3).

oneOf.description:
The reward taken just before completed enough of the constellation `set` to reach its
tier `tier`, counted from 1: the tier's effects replace the lower tier's (core#NS3).

The weapon gauge of `player` gained `amount` (more than 0, after the step cap and the
max); `value` is the gauge after. A friendly combo swing or a hit taken fills it
(ADR-SIM-9).
The full-gauge smash of `player` spent `amount`, the whole gauge (ADR-SIM-9).

The spirit level of `player` rose to `level` (1 to the style's top), by a full-gauge
smash that was not already at the top (ADR-SIM-9).

The spirit level of `player` fell to `level` (0 to the style's top less one) because
no smash came within the countdown (ADR-SIM-9).

A near miss of `player` was a perfect evade: its slow and its cooldown have just started
(ADR-SIM-8).

DownView.description: The downed state of a party player (ADR-SIM-7).

EffectEntry.description: One effect of a reward: an effect kind with the fields that kind takes.

amount.description:
What taking it adds to the effect's total, from 1 to `MAX_AMOUNT`; for a stage skill,
the levels it gives, from 1 to `MAX_SKILL_LEVELS`; for evade charges, the charges it
adds, from 1 to `MAX_EVADE_CHARGES`; for an orbit, the orbs it adds, from 1 to
`MAX_ORBS`; for range, how much wider, from 1 to `MAX_RANGE_PCT` percent; for Rune
Haste, the percent of haste, from 1 to the file's `max_rune_haste_pct`; for a type bonus,
the percent, from 1 to `MAX_TYPE_BONUS_AMOUNT`. Required by every effect but the random
rune, which has none.

depth.description:
The links of a chain of bursts, from 1 to `MAX_BURST_DEPTH`: with the `kill_burst`
effect only, and required by it.

kills.description:
The kills between two heals, from 1 to `MAX_HEAL_KILLS`: with the `heal_per_kills`
effect only, and required by it.

orbit.description: The orbit it gives: with the `orbit` effect only, and required by it.

radius.description:
How far a burst reaches, in pixels, from 1 to `MAX_BURST_RADIUS_PX`: with the
`kill_burst` effect only, and required by it. Its `amount` is the percent of hit points.

skill.description:
The stage skill it gives, one of the stage skills file's: with the `stage_skill` effect
only, and required by it.

type.description:
The damage type its bonus raises: with the `type_bonus_pct` effect only, and required
by it.

Elite.description: What makes an enemy an elite.

aura.description: A pack leader's aura: while it is alive, the non-elite enemies near it deal more.

boss_call.description: What the boss's call does to it; `join` when absent.

escort.description:
A pack leader's escort: ordinary enemies that spawn with it on a ring around it.
Kept here, with the aura, because both are about what makes this enemy an elite of its
kind, as `boss_call` is; the ring is the shrine's guardians' (`Guardians`).

mimic.description:
A mimic's disguise: until the main character comes near, it is drawn as another
sprite and nothing can touch it. Kept here, with the aura and the escort, because it is
about what makes this enemy an elite of its kind.

range.description: How near the main character's centre must come to its centre for its rules to fire.

EliteTier.description: From `start_tick` until the next tier starts, an elite is drawn by these weights.

start_tick.description: When the tier starts, in ticks from the start of the run.

weights.description: 1 to `MAX_ELITE_TYPES` elite types, each named once.

EliteType.description:
An elite type: a content ID (ADR-CONT-2) and the enemy it spawns, with what a kill of
it gives, as the fields of a wave of the schedule do. The sprite is the enemy's `base`; the
enemy must be an elite. A grade is a type; later kinds of elite add entries.

enemy.description: Checked as a wave's enemy is, and an elite.

expertise.description: The expertise points it gives; as a wave's `expertise`.

id.description: Lowercase snake_case, unique in the file; never renamed or removed once released.

stardust.description:
The Stardust a kill of it earns before the time factor, times 10; as a wave's
`stardust`.

xp.description: The experience a kill gives; as a wave's `xp`.

EliteWeight.description: How likely an elite type is to be drawn, against the other types of its tier.

elite.description: The ID of an elite type of the file's `elite_types`.

oneOf.description:
Runs `body` `count` times (at most 100). The next round starts `interval_ticks` ticks
after the body of the last one ends.

Runs `body` `count` times at once, each round turned a full turn / `count` further than
the one before.

Runs `body` `count` times at once, fanned evenly across `angle` and centred on the
direction of the attack.
Turns the direction of everything in `body` by `angle`.

A slow projectile with a required lifetime (core Z2, DS10): it flies for `ticks` ticks
(1 to `limits::MAX_ORB_TICKS`), and then `burst` runs from where it ended, as an attack of
its own. A `breakable` orb is destroyed, with no burst, by the main character's hit boxes.
Enemy attacks only; the burst holds only `zone`, `ring`, `spread`, `repeat`, `rotate` and
`wait` nodes. At most `MAX_ORBS_PER_OWNER` orbs per attacker and `MAX_ORBS_ALIVE` in all;
one over a cap is dropped.

anchor.description:
Where the orbs spawn from: the attacker, or the target as it is when the node fires
(Z3a-4). Sampled once; the orbs then fly on their own.

link.description:
Joins this orb to its neighbours in the ring it is fired in, once they are not flying
toward a halt: the beams hurt the main character. Needs an enclosing `ring`, `spread` or
`repeat` of at least 2 rounds.

offset.description: Moves the spawn point forward along the orb's direction and to the right of it.

stop_after.description:
Ticks after it is fired when the orb halts (0 to `ticks`): it stays where it is, and its
lifetime runs on. It moves on the tick it is fired, so it moves `stop_after` times.

style.description: Orb asset; absent means the default orb.

oneOf.description:
A zone that does not move (core Z1): it is placed at the `anchor`, moved by `offset`
(forward along its `direction`, and to the right of it), warns for `wind_up_ticks`,
hurts each target at most once for `active_ticks`, then ends. `ring`, `spread` and
`rotate` turn its direction, and with it the offset, as they turn an orb's.

active_ticks.description: 1 to `MAX_ZONE_TICKS`. Required, unless the zone is `warn_only`, which refuses it.

warn_only.description:
A warning only (Z3a-4): it warns for `wind_up_ticks` (1 or more) and then ends. It
never becomes active, never hurts and gives no invulnerability; its phase's `damage`,
`type` and `breaks_charge` are not used for it. It counts in `MAX_ZONES_ALIVE`.

wind_up_ticks.description: 0 to `MAX_ZONE_TICKS`; 0 is a zone that hurts at once.

EntityId.description: An entity in a run, numbered in spawn order. Agents are evaluated in this order (ADR-SIM-4).

oneOf.description:
An elite object that is not an enemy: it cannot be damaged and fights through its
guardians, who are `Enemy`s. Its `elite` flag is set.

attack.description: The attack it is making, if any.

aura_radius.description:
A pack leader's aura: the radius, around `at`, within which the non-elite
enemies deal more damage for as long as this entity is there to be drawn.

damage_over_time.description: Its damage-over-time statuses, one of a kind at most.

disguised.description:
A mimic that is still disguised: `asset` is its disguise and `elite` is false,
so the app draws an object and the minimap shows nothing. Absent when false.

elite.description: An elite enemy, which the minimap shows wherever it is.

fight.description:
A shrine's running fight: the ticks left before it leaves unkilled.
Absent for every other entity, and for a shrine nobody has touched.

kind_index.description:
Its kind, the one the Bestiary keys on: an index into the run's `KindTable`
(`Engine::kinds`) of an enemy's, an elite's, a boss's or a companion's sprite ID, or of a
boss part's own ID. Absent for a mimic still in disguise (`asset` is then its disguise).

radius.description: The hurt circle that hits use.

stagger.description:
The stagger gauge of an elite or the boss whose definition names a `stagger_max`: what it
holds now (0 while it is staggered) and its maximum. Absent for every other entity.

statuses.description:
Its statuses and auras, sorted by ID. An enemy can show `atk_up`, `vulnerable`, `slow`,
`bleed`, `poison`, `burn`, `stun`, `flinch`, `knocked_down` and `aura`, each with `remaining` and
`total` ticks; `flinch` and `knocked_down` are the enemy's own control state, shown as statuses.

EquipAction.description:
An equipment action a player makes on a step (ADR-SIM-7). Every operand is an index; what an
inventory index, a slot index, a star-pool index and a style-path option index count is the
engine's rule to define, and the type bounds none of them.

oneOf.description: Put the inventory item `item` into the empty slot `slot`.
Put the inventory item `item` into the occupied slot `slot`.
Extract the inventory item `item`.
Craft with the star at index `star` of the setup's star pool.
Take option `option` on the weapon's in-run style path.

EquipmentCategory.description: One slot category of the equipment layout.

drop_weight_default.description:
The weight the Star Chart screen starts this category at, 0 to `drop_weight_max`: the app
writes it into the setup; core never reads it (a missing key is 0 extra). Absent: 0.

drop_weight_max.description:
The most extra drop weight in percent the player's setup may give this category
(`RunSetup::drop_weights`, ADR-SAVE-17), 0 to `MAX_DROP_WEIGHT_PCT`. Absent: 0, so a pack
released before it allows none.

id.description: The category's ID, unique within the list.

EquipmentRules.description:
The equipment rules (ADR-CONT-3): the slot layout, the level curve, the Starlight values and
the drop numbers, which a designer tunes. Bounds are code.

boss_bonus.description: What a boss kill pays, 0 to `MAX_STARLIGHT`.

boss_drops.description: The drops a boss kill rolls for each member who is up, 0 to `MAX_BOSS_DROPS`.

categories.description: The slot categories in slot order, 1 to `MAX_EQUIP_CATEGORIES`.

kills_to_next.description:
The kills a slot needs for each next level: exactly `MAX_SLOT_LEVEL - 1` entries, strictly
rising, each 1 to `MAX_STARLIGHT`.

level_pct.description: What each level adds to a star's amount, in percent, 1 to `MAX_LEVEL_PCT`.

rarities.description: Every rarity once, from common up.

rune_extract.description: What extracting a rune gives, 1 to `MAX_STARLIGHT`.

rune_share_permille.description: The chance in a thousand that a drop is a rune, 0 to 1000.

rune_slots.description:
The rune slots after the category slots, 1 to `MAX_CATEGORY_SLOTS`. The category slots,
the rune slots and the Lumine slot add up to at most `MAX_EQUIP_SLOTS`.

Evade.description:
A dash with invulnerability, on charges. A press with a charge ready
dashes `distance` over `ticks`, along the movement direction, or along the facing when the
stick is centred; the stick is ignored until the dash ends, and a press during it with a
charge ready starts the next dash at once. Invulnerability counts from the press, and so
does the cooldown of the charge it spent: each spent charge recovers on its own timer.

charges.description: The charges a run starts with: 1 when absent.

distance.description: A length in 1/256 pixel units. In files it is the plain integer.

max_charges.description: The most charges rewards can raise it to: `charges` when absent.

charges.description:
The charges held, ready or recovering: from the stage's `charges`, raised by rewards up
to its `max_charges`.

dash_left.description: Ticks of the dash still to move: 0 when not dashing.

ready.description:
The charges ready: a press on the next tick dashes when it is more than 0, even during a
dash.

recovering.description:
Ticks left on each spent charge, in the order they were spent; each counts from the
press that spent it.

ExpertiseEffect.description:
What taking an option or a style does: one of the run stats' effect kinds, under the same
names, or a wider combo.

oneOf.description:
No stat: a level that grants only mechanic `kinds`. Its `amount` is absent or 0 and its
`kinds` are not empty; a rule of `sim_version` 2.

Every combo step's hit box `amount` percent larger, as the range reward widens it,
at most `MAX_RANGE_PCT`.

growth_pct.description:
Each level after 10 needs the level before's points times `growth_pct / 100`: above 100,
at most `MAX_GROWTH_PCT`.

max_points.description:
The most points any level needs, where the growth saturates: at least the last
threshold, at most `MAX_LEVEL_POINTS`.

thresholds.description:
The points each of levels 1 to 10 needs from the level before, the first from 0:
exactly `TABLE_LEVELS`, rising strictly, each from 1 to `max_points`.

weapons.description: Every weapon preset of the registry, each once.

oneOf.description: The weapon's three styles, at the level table's style level: fixed, no reroll.
The fixed upgrades of the chosen style, at the table's upgrade levels: no reroll.
The fixed capstones of the chosen style, at the table's capstone level: no reroll.

ExpertiseOption.description: One option: a candidate of a common offer, or a fixed choice of a style.

amount.description:
What taking it adds to the effect's total, from 1 to the effect's most; absent (0) for
the effect `none`.

id.description: The option's own ID, unique within its weapon.

kinds.description:
The mechanic kinds it grants, at most `MAX_LEVEL_KINDS`; absent or empty for none
(`sim_version` 2).

ExpertisePoints.description:
What a hit and a kill by an A or a B step of a combo add to the one expertise gauge
: elites, bosses and the Star-Hunter give far more. Other damage gives none.
A hit on a boss part gives the boss's points per hit; its break is not a kill.

kill.description: Points for the kill, at most `MAX_EXPERTISE_PER_KILL`.

ExpertiseView.description:
The one expertise gauge of both weapons: its level, from 0, its points
toward the next, the style chosen and the Main style's path
taken (ADR-REPL-5).

path.description:
The choices taken from the style's path, in level order: its two upgrades, then its
capstone.

points.description: Points gained toward the next level.

style.description: The weapon's style, chosen at the level table's style level and held for the run.

anyOf.description: The attack's argument at this index.
Ticks since the attack started: 0 on its first tick.

A draw from the run's SplitMix64 (ADR-SIM-2), from `lo` to `hi` inclusive; `lo` if the
range is empty. Expressions are evaluated left to right, so the order of draws is fixed.
A literal; written as a plain integer.

Expr.description:
A fixed-point expression (ADR-SIM-4): a literal, an input, or an operator. No variables,
loops or recursion beyond the tree itself.

Facing.description: A direction as a unit vector times `trig::SCALE`; `y` grows down the screen.

GaugeSpend.description: What a full gauge is spent on: a closed list, one variant now.

oneOf.description:
A B press with the gauge full plays `attack` in place of the step's own and empties the
gauge. It is checked as a player's attack and differs from every attack of the weapon's
base tree (the orb clear tells it by its compiled index).

GaugeSpendKind.description: What a gauge kind spends its full gauge on, by name only.

max.description: The style's maximum: the bar is this long, and the gauge is full at `value == max`.

value.description: The gauge now, in gauge units.

Guardians.description:
The guardians of a shrine, or the escort of a pack leader: `count` ordinary enemies placed on
a ring of `radius` around it, evenly spaced from the east, kept on the map. The enemy cap
still applies to them: one it refuses is not spawned.

enemy.description: Not an elite and not a shrine; it does not summon.

radius.description: How far from the shrine's centre they stand.

HealPickupView.description: A heal pickup on the map (see `DomainEvent::HealDropped`).

Healing.description: Healing (see `Stage::heal`). Hit points are in the stage's own scale.

amount.description: The hit points a pickup heals when the main character takes it, from 1 up.

boss_pct.description: The percent of the main character's most hit points a boss kill heals, from 0 to 100.

cap.description: The most pickups on the map at once, from 1 up. A kill with the map full drops none.

drop_one_in.description: A regular enemy's kill drops a heal pickup with a chance of 1 in this many, from 1 up.

pickup_radius.description: How near the main character's centre a pickup must come to be taken.

HeldView.description: What an inventory place holds: a star, by its reward ID and rarity, or a rune.

HitBox.description:
A hit box, in the attacker's own frame: `offset` is forward along the attacker's facing
and to its right, from the `anchor`.

radius.description: A length in 1/256 pixel units. In files it is the plain integer.

oneOf.description: A circle sector centred on the facing, `half_angle` to each side.

radius.description: A length in 1/256 pixel units. In files it is the plain integer.

oneOf.description:
A rectangle from its starting point (the anchor and `offset`) along the facing turned by
`angle`: `length` long and `width` wide, half of it to each side.

angle.description: Turn from the facing, in 1/256 degree; positive turns toward the right.

length.description: A length in 1/256 pixel units. In files it is the plain integer.

width.description: A length in 1/256 pixel units. In files it is the plain integer.

HitKind.description: What kind of thing hurt the main character.

oneOf.description: A hit box of an attack, or an orb that an attack fired.
A zone an attack placed.
The beam between two linked orbs.

attack.description: The attack preset it came from; absent for an inline attack.

owner.description: The attacker that owns it (`Hit::source` is the same kind of ID).

Hold.description:
A held step: an attack that goes on while the button stays held, then a
release attack when it is let go, or at `max_ticks`. The hold begins where the step's
recovery after its last `active` phase would, so that phase is the hold's place.

loop.description:
The attack that runs while held: its phases are `active`, and it starts again from its
first phase each time it ends, each loop a new attack with its facing locked at its start.

move_pct.description: The main character's movement speed while held, in percent; 100 when absent.

release.description:
The attack released when the button is let go, or at `max_ticks`, with its facing locked
when it starts.

HoldView.description:
A hold in progress: the ticks held so far, 0 on the tick it began, and the
most it can last. The release comes on the tick the button is let go or the maximum is reached.

action.description:
An equipment action made on this step. It is recorded as an ACTIONS step, never inside a
TICKS block, and is not part of the schema 1 stream. `Engine::step` does not read it: no
rule accepts an action yet.

assist.description: Aim assist is on for this tick, a switch: a combo step faces the target.

auto.description:
Auto mode is on for this tick, a switch: the simulation plays the auto combo
at the target. Its presses come from the state, never from this record.

evade.description: The evade button (X) is held on this tick: a press dashes when an evade is ready.

interact.description:
The interact button is held on this tick: the revive hold (ADR-SIM-7). Read by the down
and revive rules only; the simulation ignores it until they exist. Schema 2 only: the
schema 1 stream cannot carry it.

main.description: The Main attack button (A) is held on this tick.

move_x.description:
Movement direction and strength, each −127 to 127 (−128 counts as −127). The simulation
clamps the vector to length 127 and scales it to the character's speed.

skill.description:
The stage skill button (Y) is held on this tick: a press uses the skill in the slot when
it is ready.

smash.description: The smash button (B) is held on this tick.

Introduced.description:
The `sim_version` of every ID the pack's files introduce, per file. Each list names each of
its file's IDs once, in any order, and nothing else; the run stats', rewards' and stage
skills' lists share their file's count budget.

constellations.description:
The constellations (core#NS4). Optional: a pack released with the file but before the
list has none, stays valid and records no version for its sets. A list names each set of
the pack's file once.

elite_types.description: The elite types of the `time_limit` mode file.

expertise.description: One entry for each weapon of the expertise.

IntroducedId.description: An ID and the `sim_version` that introduced it: at most the pack's.

KindIndex.description:
The index of a kind in the run's `KindTable`. It is only meaningful with that run's table:
key anything that outlives the run on the ID.

LevelKindsView.description: The kinds one level of a style's path grants.

kinds.description: What taking it grants; empty for a level that names none.

offer.description: Style (the style pick itself), Upgrade or Capstone.

option.description: The style's or the choice's ID at that level.

LevelTable.description:
The expertise levels of a run's style path: the level of the style choice, of
each of the two style upgrades and of the capstone. Every other level is a common offer.
The levels rise in that order, strictly, each from 1 to `MAX_STYLE_LEVEL`.

Levels.description: How much experience each level needs.

xp.description:
The experience each next level needs, the first from level 1 to 2; the last entry
repeats for every level after it.

Link.description:
The beams between the orbs of one ring (Z3a-3): between slot `j` and slot `j + 1` of the orbs
one `ring`, `spread` or `repeat` fires (the last to the first, unless there are only two), while
both are on the map. A beam is a rectangle `width` across that hurts the main character, each
beam at most once per `rehit_ticks`.

damage.description: The damage of a beam hit; absent means the orb's own.

Map.description:
The rectangle the run plays on, from its top-left corner, and where the main character
starts. The main character and companions are clamped to it; enemies and orbs leave once
they are more than `FIELD_MARGIN` outside it.

facing.description:
The angle the main character faces at the start, as `Direction::Absolute` takes it: 0 is
straight down the screen, a half turn is up. Absent means up, as it always was
(core#147). Between 0 and a full turn, not including it.

height.description: A length in 1/256 pixel units. In files it is the plain integer.

start.description: The centre of the map when absent.

width.description: A length in 1/256 pixel units. In files it is the plain integer.

MapView.description: The map's width and height, from its top-left corner.

height.description: A length in 1/256 pixel units. In files it is the plain integer.

width.description: A length in 1/256 pixel units. In files it is the plain integer.

MatchUp.description: The match-up a hit got, which the `Hit` event reports.

max_type_bonus_pct.description:
The most the type bonuses that apply to an attack add to its damage, in percent, 1 to
`MAX_TYPE_BONUS_PCT`: their sum saturates here.

resisted_pct.description: Percent less damage from a resisted hit, 0 to `MAX_MATCH_UP_PCT`.

strong_pct.description: Percent less damage from a strong hit, 0 to `MAX_MATCH_UP_PCT`.

weak_pct.description: Percent more damage from a weak hit, 0 to `MAX_MATCH_UP_PCT`.

Mimic.description:
What a mimic is. It starts disguised: it does not move or attack, nothing damages
it, aim assist and the selectors pass it over, and it is drawn as `disguise`. The first tick
the main character's centre is within `reveal_radius` of its centre (the edge counts) it
reveals, for good: from that tick's collisions on it takes damage, and from the next tick it
acts by its movement and rules like a grade elite. The boss's call skips it while it is
disguised and calls it once it is revealed. Needs `boss_call` `join`, and no aura, escort,
shrine or flee movement.

disguise.description: Asset ID of the sprite it is drawn as while disguised (ADR-CONT-7).

bank.description:
Whether a fail banks anything and a clear pays a bank. Off: a fail pays `pay_pct` and
banks nothing; a bank already saved stays until it is on again.

bank_cap.description:
The most a bank of this mode (at each difficulty) holds, at most `MAX_BANK_CAP`;
Stardust that would pass it is lost.

bank_pct.description:
The percent of a fail's Stardust that is banked, rounded up and never more than what the
pay leaves, from 0 to 100; with `pay_pct` at most 100.

id.description: A mode ID of the registry, once in the file.

pay_pct.description: The percent of a fail's Stardust that is paid at once, rounded down, from 0 to 100.

oneOf.description:
Circles the main character. A companion is set on its circle; an enemy moves to its
place on it, at most its orbit step plus 4 pixels a tick (ADR-SIM-5).

radius.description: A length in 1/256 pixel units. In files it is the plain integer.

oneOf.description:
Trails the main character at a distance, at most `speed` a tick (a tank's is slower);
absent, 4 pixels a tick as it always was (ADR-SIM-5).

distance.description: A length in 1/256 pixel units. In files it is the plain integer.

speed.description: A length in 1/256 pixel units. In files it is the plain integer.

oneOf.description:
Keeps to a point. A companion is set on it; an enemy walks to it from where it is, at
most 4 pixels a tick, and walks back when it is pushed off it (ADR-SIM-5).
Moves at a constant velocity per tick.

vx.description: A length in 1/256 pixel units. In files it is the plain integer.

vy.description: A length in 1/256 pixel units. In files it is the plain integer.

oneOf.description:
An elite's (it needs the `elite` field): holds its place until it is disturbed, by
damage or by the main character coming within `disturb_radius` of its centre, then runs
directly away from the main character at `speed` a tick, kept on the map, and leaves it
unkilled `leave_after_ticks` ticks after the disturbance.

disturb_radius.description: A length in 1/256 pixel units. In files it is the plain integer.

speed.description: A length in 1/256 pixel units. In files it is the plain integer.

oneOf.description:
An elite's (it needs the `elite` field, with `boss_call` `stay`): an object that cannot be
damaged and does nothing until the main character's body touches it. It then activates
once: its guardians appear on a ring around it and it gives its kill reward when they are
all dead within `fight_ticks` ticks of the touch, else it leaves unkilled.

forward.description: A length in 1/256 pixel units. In files it is the plain integer.

right.description: A length in 1/256 pixel units. In files it is the plain integer.

attack.description:
Its attack's phases, 1 to `MAX_RUNE_PHASES`: hit boxes centred on the point hit, facing
the way the main character faces as it fires; a phase's `type` is its hits' damage type.

cooldown_ticks.description:
Ticks it waits after it fires, 1 to `MAX_RUNE_COOLDOWN_TICKS`, at least its attack's
length.

damage.description: The base damage of its attack's hits, 1 to `MAX_DAMAGE`.

missiles.description:
Homing missiles only: how many it launches, 1 to `MAX_HOMING_MISSILES`, each running
`attack` as its flight.

range.description:
Homing missiles only: how far from the main character its targets may be, 1 to
`MAX_ASSIST_RANGE`, as aim assist's range.

OrbView.description: Orbs carry no ID or asset name: thousands are drawn per tick, batched by `style`.

breakable.description: An orb the main character's hit box breaks.

link_to.description:
The index, in this list, of the orb a live beam runs to from this one (a cage's `link`);
the beam is as wide as `link.width` and hurts the main character.

link_width.description:
The width of that beam, in 1/256 pixel (`link.width` of the content); set exactly when
`link_to` is.

radius.description: A length in 1/256 pixel units. In files it is the plain integer.

style.description:
The orb asset, as an index into the orb asset IDs the stage uses, in order of
first appearance.

vx.description:
How far the orb moves each tick, in 1/256 pixel: it moved by this to reach `at`, and
moves by it again on the next tick. The frontend draws it at `at` plus this times the
fraction of the tick that has passed.

vy.description: A length in 1/256 pixel units. In files it is the plain integer.

Orbit.description:
Orbs that turn round the main character and attack on their own. Each orb runs
`attack` in an attack slot of its own, at the main character's attack stat, its facing
turned `turn_per_tick` further every tick and the orbs spaced evenly round the turn: the
attack's hit box offset is how far out an orb is. A round of attacks starts when the orbit
arrives and again `cooldown_ticks` after a round's start, once the round before has ended.

attack.description: The attack each orb runs, validated as any attack is.

cooldown_ticks.description: Ticks from a round's start to the next one's, from 1 to `MAX_ORBIT_COOLDOWN_TICKS`.

turn_per_tick.description:
How far the orbs turn a tick, in 1/256 degree, toward the right for positive angles,
at most `MAX_ORBIT_TURN` either way.

OrbitView.description:
An orbit held. Its orbs' attacks are in the main character's `attacks`, in slots
`2 + 8 × its place in orbits` and on.

cooldown_left.description:
Ticks until the next round may start, counted from the last one's start; 0 while a
round that outlasts it goes on.

orbs.description: Its orbs: those of the next round.

reward.description: The reward that gave it, for its name.

oneOf.description: The stage was cleared: this is what a replay has to prove (ADR-REPL-6).
The main character died, or the stage ran out of ticks.

PackFile.description: The pack file. Each content file is the JSON object its own schema describes.

attack_presets.description: The attack presets (CS1b-1). Required: the rules read them.

constellations.description:
The sets of named stars (core#NS3), checked against the pack's own rewards. Optional: a
pack released before it has no sets.

rewards.description: Checked against the pack's own stage skills.

rules.description: The crowd target and the cap's headroom (DIR1). Required: the simulation reads it.

sim_version.description:
The `sim_version` the pack needs: the version of every file it holds; the stages in
`modes` also carry it, as every stage does.

star_chart.description:
The Star Chart's Stardust prices (ADR-SAVE-17), checked against the pack's own weapons,
perk sets, stage skills, run stats and starting unlocks. Optional: a pack released before
it has none, and reports no catalogue, never a guessed one.

stardust.description:
The rules the app pays a failed run's Stardust by. Optional: a pack
released before it yields the bundled file.

starting_unlocks.description:
What a new save begins with (DS5 Q10). Optional: a pack released before it has none, and
reports the starting unlocks as unknown.

threat_colours.description:
The colours an enemy's attack areas may be drawn in (ADR-CONT-1, ADR-BRDG-4): an ID and
an RGB value each, which an enemy or a boss may name. Optional: a pack released before it
has an empty table, and an enemy naming a colour is then refused.

trial.description: The `trial` mode's stage, checked as any stage is.

tutorial.description: The `tutorial` mode's stage, checked as any stage is.

PacksFile.description: The manifest as it sits in the file; `Packs::from_bytes` checks it.

channels.description: One channel per core minor, keyed `"<major>.<minor>"`, at most 16.

seq.description: Rises with every release; a client never accepts a lower one than it has seen.

PatternView.description:
A big pattern announced in the snapshot: its content ID, the ticks the count-down
started with and the ticks left until it starts.

PerfectEvadeView.description: A player's perfect evade after the near miss (ADR-SIM-8).

cooldown_left.description: Ticks until another near miss can be perfect.

reach.description: The slow's reach around the player, in 1/256 px.

slow_left.description: Ticks of the slow left; enemies within `reach` of the player's `at` are slowed.

PerkEffect.description:
What a perk does, `amount` times over. The closed list of perk effects; the
stat kinds are the run stats' (`StatEffect`) and add to the same totals.

oneOf.description: `amount` more hit points at most, from tick 0 (the run starts at the most).
`amount` hit points back every second (60 ticks), never beyond the most.
`amount` percent more damage from every attack of the main character.
`amount` percent faster attacks.
An `amount` percent shorter evade cooldown.
`amount` percent more movement speed.
`amount` more rerolls for offers, on top of the stage's and the setup's.
`amount` more banishes for offers, on top of the stage's.

`amount` percent more weight for the named stars a member's drops roll (equipment mode,
`sim_version` 2; a no-op in the frozen rules).

category.description:
The equipment category a `drop_weight` entry weighs, one of the rewards file's: with
that effect only, and required by it.

effects.description: Its effects, at most `MAX_PERK_EFFECTS`, each kind once.

id.description: The set's own ID, unique within the file.

rules.description: Reactions, evaluated like an agent's rules.

timeline.description: The choreography, one step at a time.

until.description: Ends the phase; absent on the last phase, which lasts until the boss dies.

oneOf.description: The telegraph: its hit box is the warned area, and it deals no damage.
Its hit box deals damage.

Player.description: The main character, as the creator configured it; challengers get exactly this.

defence.description:
Reduces every hit the main character takes; 0 when absent. It moves to the
run's setup when the setup exists.

evade.description:
Skill 1. It moves to the run's setup with the character when the setup exists
.

weapon.description:
The one weapon, whose combos the main character makes by hand with both buttons
. It moves to the run's setup when the setup exists (ADR-REPL-5).

PlayerIdx.description:
Which player: the place in `State::players`. Player `i` is entity `i`; the boss and the
companions come after the players. An enum of the `MAX_PLAYERS` places, so that an index into
the players' array needs no bounds check (a tick indexes it thousands of times, ADR-SIM-6).

attacks.description:
Its attacks in progress, by slot: 0 the combo, 1 the stage skill, then 8 for each orbit,
one for each orb, in the order the orbits came, then from 34 one for each
on-hit rune, by its place in `Rune::ALL`.

auto_charge.description:
The level auto mode is charging the current step to, while it is: its own
field, so `charge` stays the player's and the frontend slows only for that, never for auto mode.

charge.description: The current step charging, if it is.

combo.description: Where it is in its Main weapon's combos.

crit_chance_pct.description:
What the combat rewards taken add up to (core#NS2b): the chance of a crit in percent
(at most 75), a crit's bonus damage beyond twice (at most 300), an echo's percent of a
hit (at most 100), and a kill burst's percent of max hit points, radius in pixels and
chain depth; each 0 while none is held.

down.description: Downed state when the player has 0 HP in a party (ADR-SIM-7).

gauge.description: The weapon gauge of its style, while the style grants one (ADR-SIM-9); absent otherwise.

hold.description: The current step held, if it is.

inventory.description:
What its inventory holds, in drop order (equipment mode, `sim_version` 2; empty at 1). The app
sorts it by rarity.

invulnerable.description: Ticks of invulnerability left, after a hit or from an evade; the frontend can flash it.

kill_heal.description:
Hit points (the stage's scale) the heal-per-kills rewards taken heal together every
`kill_heal_every` kills; both 0 while none is held.

orbits.description: The orbits rewards gave, in the order they came.

out.description: Out state when a downed player's out timer expired (ADR-SIM-7).

perfect_evade.description:
The perfect evade's slow and cooldown, while either runs and the run's rules name the
perfect evade (ADR-SIM-8); absent otherwise.

pickup_radius_pct.description:
The pickup circle of stars and heal pickups is that much wider, in percent: the pickup
radius rewards taken plus the `PickupRadiusPct` stat, held to `MAX_PICKUP_RADIUS_TOTAL_PCT`.

pool_held.description:
For each star of the setup's star pool, in pool order (the index `Craft` takes): whether
a craft of it is refused because this player already holds that named star. Empty in a
stage run alone and at `sim_version` 1.

pull.description: The stage skill's pull while it pulls.

range_pct.description:
What the range rewards taken add up to, in percent, before the clamp at
`MAX_RANGE_PCT`. The wider hit boxes are already in `attacks`.

rune_haste_pct.description:
What the Rune Haste rewards taken add up to, in percent, before the clamp at
the rewards file's `max_rune_haste_pct`. The shorter cooldowns and intervals are already in the
runes' cooldowns and the statuses' timers.

runes.description: The runes its Main weapon holds, in the order drawn.

shield.description: The stage skill's shield while it holds.

skill.description: The stage skill in its slot, if a reward has filled it.

skill_cooldown_pct.description:
What the skill cooldown rewards taken add up to, in percent, before the clamp at
`MAX_SKILL_COOLDOWN_TOTAL_PCT`: the stage skill's cooldown is already that much shorter.

slots.description:
Its equipment slots in layout order, then the Lumine slot last when the run has one
(equipment mode; empty at `sim_version` 1). An action addresses them by this order: an index
into the list, the Lumine slot one past the others.

spirit.description:
The spirit level of its style, while the style grants one, at level 0 too (ADR-SIM-9);
absent otherwise.

starlight.description: Its Starlight balance (equipment mode; absent reads as 0).

statuses.description: Its statuses, sorted by ID: the timed buffs and debuffs it holds.

super_armour.description:
The player has super armour: a hit that breaks a charge or a hold does not break it. Derived
each tick from its charge and its running step, not a timer; absent is the key missing.

target.description:
The enemy aim assist and auto mode would face, while either is on, so the
frontend can mark it.

tree_ready.description:
The weapon tree point it holds (equipment mode); absent at `sim_version` 1 and while none is
held.

type_bonuses.description:
What the type bonus rewards taken add up to, for each damage type that has any, in the
order of `DamageType::ALL`, before the clamp at the match-up file's `max_type_bonus_pct`
.

weapon_stats.description:
The weapon's stat sets (equipment mode): the base set and every tree's set at the weapon's
level; absent at `sim_version` 1, without an expertise gauge and for an inline weapon.

Point.description: A point on the playfield, from its top-left corner.

x.description: A length in 1/256 pixel units. In files it is the plain integer.

y.description: A length in 1/256 pixel units. In files it is the plain integer.

Press.description: Which button's press took a combo step: A or B.

PricedId.description: One item sold at one price.

id.description:
A weapon, perk set or stage skill of the pack, once in its list and not a starting unlock;
in a weapon's style row, one of that weapon's styles.

price.description: The price in tenths of Stardust, from 1 to `MAX_PRICE`.

Profile.description:
What an enemy, an elite, a boss or a boss part is weak and strong against. The
validator holds each type at most once in each list, and never in both.

ProgressView.description: Where the run stands in experience, levels and stat points (ADR-REPL-5).

spent.description: Points spent on each run stat, in the run stats' order (ADR-CONT-1).

xp.description: Experience gained toward the next level.

xp_next.description: Experience the next level needs; 0 at the highest level.

radius.description: A length in 1/256 pixel units. In files it is the plain integer.

ticks_left.description: Ticks it still pulls, this one included.

Rarity.description: A reward's rarity, from the most common up (ADR-REPL-5).

RarityCost.description: What carrying a star of one rarity costs, in Lumine.

RarityStarlight.description: What one rarity of star is worth in Stardust (equipment mode).

craft_price.description: What crafting a star of it costs, `extract` to `MAX_STARLIGHT`.

extract.description: What extracting a star of it gives, 1 to `MAX_STARLIGHT`.

RarityWeights.description:
The weight of each rarity in a draw; a rarity left out weighs 0. A tier's highest rarity is
the highest one that weighs more than 0.

RepeatAnchorKind.description: Where a repeat lands: on what the step's last `active` phase hit, or on the place it hit.

oneOf.description: The enemies that phase hit, still standing when the repeat is due.
The place the hit box was centred on, with the range the step had.

final_hash.description:
The FNV-1a 64 state hash after the last tick (ADR-SIM-3), 16 lowercase hex digits. Hex,
because JSON readers that use doubles cannot hold every 64-bit integer.

inputs.description: The per-tick inputs, packed as described in the module documentation, then base64.

schema_version.description:
The `schema_version` the file was written at. This game reads the range
`FIRST_SCHEMA_VERSION..=NEWEST_READ_SCHEMA_VERSION` and writes `SCHEMA_VERSION`; one below
the range is read only through a migration, else it is `Older`; a newer one is `Newer`
(ADR-REPL-2).

sim_version.description:
The `sim_version` the file was written at. This game reads a file at any version
from `FIRST_SIM_VERSION` to its own `SIM_VERSION`; an older one is read only through a
migration, else it is `Older`; a newer one is `Newer` (ADR-REPL-2).

stage_sha256.description:
SHA-256 of the exact stage file bytes, lowercase hex: a changed stage invalidates the
replay.

ticks.description:
Ticks recorded, at most the stage's length. A replay that proves a clear ends on the
tick of the clear.

Reward.description:
One reward an offer can hold. In a file it is written with an `effects` list of 1 to
`MAX_REWARD_EFFECTS` entries, or in the released form, with one effect's fields on the
reward itself, which reads as a list of one (ADR-CONT-2).

effect.description: The released form's single effect: with its `skill`, `orbit`, `type` and `amount`.

effects.description: The effects, 1 to `MAX_REWARD_EFFECTS`: instead of `effect` and the fields of one.

RewardEffect.description:
What taking a reward does: one of the run stats' effect kinds, under the same names, a stage
skill, more evade charges, an orbit, range, a type bonus, or a random rune.

oneOf.description: The stage skill the reward's `skill` names, `amount` levels of it.

`amount` more evade charges, never beyond the stage's `max_charges`; each arrives ready
.
The reward's `orbit`, with `amount` more orbs, never beyond `MAX_ORBS`.

Every combo step of the Main weapon `amount` percent wider, as the expertise range
option widens it, adding up over the picks.
The main character's attacks of the reward's `type` `amount` percent stronger.
Its attacks of every attack type (Slash, Pierce, Strike) `amount` percent stronger.
Its attacks of every element `amount` percent stronger.

Every on-hit rune's cooldown and every damage-over-time tick interval the main character
applies `amount` percent of haste shorter, adding up over the picks: see
`rune_haste_ticks`.

One rune the Main weapon does not hold, drawn from the run's generator when the reward
is picked, never before: an offer shows it hidden. It is offered only while
the Main lacks a rune.

Hit points the main character regenerates each second, `amount` more (the perk
`regen`'s counter).

The pickup circle of falling stars and heal pickups `amount` percent wider, adding up
over the picks to `MAX_PICKUP_RADIUS_TOTAL_PCT`.

The stage skill's cooldown `amount` percent shorter, adding up over the picks to
`MAX_SKILL_COOLDOWN_TOTAL_PCT`.

A heal of `amount` hit points (the stage's scale) each time the main character has
defeated `kills` enemies: kills that give credit only, not a self-destruct. The picks
add their amounts and heal at the shortest interval among them.

One more candidate in every offer, at most `MAX_OFFER_CANDIDATES` in all. Its `amount`
is 1.
`amount` more rerolls for the run, as the perk `extra_rerolls` gives them.
`amount` more banishes for the run, as the perk `extra_banishes` gives them.

`amount` percent more chance that a hit of the main character is a critical hit, adding
up over the picks to `MAX_CRIT_CHANCE_TOTAL_PCT`.

A critical hit does `amount` percent more damage than the base twice, adding up over
the picks to `MAX_CRIT_DAMAGE_TOTAL_PCT`.

Each hit of the main character is repeated once, a tick later, on the same target, for
`amount` percent of its damage; the picks add up to `MAX_ECHO_HIT_PCT`.

A kill by the main character bursts: it damages the other enemies within `radius`
pixels for `amount` percent of the dead enemy's maximum hit points, and a burst kill
bursts again, down to `depth` links.

`amount` more links on the chain of kill bursts, up to `MAX_BURST_DEPTH` in all: it adds
to the depth of a `kill_burst` held, in whatever order they came, and does nothing
alone.

equipment.description:
The equipment rules; absent in a file made before them, which then cannot start an
equipment run (kept packs, ADR-CONT-5).

max_rune_haste_pct.description:
The most Rune Haste the picks add up to, in percent, 1 to `MAX_RUNE_HASTE_PCT`
(app#298); absent, `DEFAULT_MAX_RUNE_HASTE_PCT`. A reward gives at most this.

rarities.description:
What carrying a star of each rarity costs, in Lumine: every rarity
once, from common up, each 1 to `run_setup::MAX_LUMINE`. The run setup's carried stars
are priced from this list.

rewards.description: The rewards, in the order offers draw them from.

charges.description: Times the rule may fire; absent means unlimited.

cooldown_ticks.description: Ticks after firing before the rule is ready again.

once.description: Fires at most once (the same as one charge, kept for editor clarity).

self_destruct.description:
An enemy that fires this rule removes itself with it, as an exploder does. It is gone
at the end of the tick, but it was not defeated: it gives no experience, expertise or
Stardust and drops no star or heal pickup, and the burst's attack still fires. An
exploder the main character kills before the rule fires gives its full credit. Ignored
for a companion and the boss.

aggro_decay.description: Aggro lost every tick (ADR-SIM-4), in stored units: 0 to `limits::MAX_AGGRO`.

aggro_per_buff.description: Aggro raised by a buff (ADR-SIM-4), in stored units: 0 to `limits::MAX_AGGRO`.

aggro_per_damage.description: Aggro raised per point of damage dealt (ADR-SIM-4), in stored units: 0 to 100.

aggro_per_heal_point.description: Aggro raised per point healed (ADR-SIM-4), in stored units: 0 to 100.

boss_arrival_above.description: How far above the main character a horde boss arrives, in 1/256 px: 0 to 1,024 px.

cap_headroom_pct.description: How far above the target the cap stands, in percent, from 25 to 30.

control_immune_ticks.description:
Ticks an enemy is immune to hard controls after one is refused for its count: 1 to 600.
Only with `control_repeat_pcts`.

control_repeat_pcts.description:
What percent of its ticks each further hard control (a stun) on one enemy keeps: 1 to
`limits::MAX_CONTROL_REPEATS` (8) entries of 1 to 100; the first control keeps the first
entry, and a control past the last entry is refused. Named together with
`control_reset_ticks` and `control_immune_ticks`, `sim_version` 2 only. Absent: the stun
immunity of the run stats alone.

control_reset_ticks.description:
Ticks without a hard control after which an enemy's count of them starts over: 1 to
`limits::MAX_CONTROL_RESET_TICKS` (600). Only with `control_repeat_pcts`.

counter_stun_ticks.description:
The ticks a counter stuns a regular enemy or an elite (an elite for its share): 1 to
`validate::limits::MAX_STUN_TICKS` (120). `sim_version` 2 only. Absent: a counter stuns
nothing (it still cancels the attack and fills the gauge).

crit_damage_base_pct.description: What a critical hit deals before any bonus, in percent: 100 to 1,000.

crowd_target.description:
The enemies a horde run keeps alive: wave spawns that fall due at it are held. From 1 to
the most that keeps the cap within the engine ceiling (384 at a headroom of 30).

default_xp.description: The experience of a summon or a wave that gives none: 0 to `limits::MAX_ENEMY_XP`.

defence_k.description: The defence that halves a hit, in stored units: 1 to 1,000,000.

down_bonus_pct.description:
The percent a smash hit on a knocked-down enemy deals more: 1 to `limits::MAX_PCT`
(1,000). Only with `down_ticks`. Absent: none.

down_ticks.description:
The ticks a regular enemy lies knocked down when a smash's knockback lands on it: 1 to
`limits::MAX_DOWN_TICKS` (180). `sim_version` 2 only. Absent: a knockback is a push only.

flinch_immune_ticks.description:
Ticks after a flinch ends in which the enemy cannot flinch again: 0 to
`limits::MAX_FLINCH_IMMUNE_TICKS` (120). Only with `flinch_ticks`. Absent: 0.

flinch_ticks.description:
Ticks an enemy that names a `poise` flinches for when a hit deals at least that much
poise damage: 1 to `limits::MAX_FLINCH_TICKS` (60). `sim_version` 2 only. Absent: no
enemy flinches, and no enemy may name a `poise`.

hit_invulnerable_ticks.description: Ticks of invulnerability after the main character is hit: 0 to 600.

leash_land_x.description: Where the leash lands an enemy to the side of the view's centre, in 1/256 px: the spawn edge (420 px + `spawn_margin`) to `leash_reach_x`.

leash_land_y.description: The same above or below, in 1/256 px: the spawn edge (180 px + `spawn_margin`) to `leash_reach_y`.

leash_reach_x.description: How far to the side of the view's centre a regular enemy may be before the leash moves it, in 1/256 px: 1 to 4,096 px.

leash_reach_y.description: The same above or below, in 1/256 px: 1 to 4,096 px.

offer_timer_ticks.description:
Ticks a timed run's open offer waits for a pick before its first option is taken
(ADR-SIM-7 point 4): 1 to 3,600 (`MAX_OFFER_TIMER_TICKS`). A `stop` run never reads it.
Deprecated (ADR-CONT-2): read by no run; absent in a pack of `sim_version` 2, where only
300 is accepted. Absent: 300.

orb_clear_radius.description:
The radius of the orb clear (`sim_version` 2): when a full-gauge attack starts its first
active tick, every breakable orb whose centre is this near the player's is removed, in
1/256 px, 1 px to `MAX_ORB_CLEAR_RADIUS` (420) px, the edge included. Absent: no clear.

orb_radius.description: A friendly orb's hit circle, in 1/256 px: 1 to `limits::MAX_RADIUS`.

orbit_step.description: An orbiting agent's turn a tick, in 1/256 degree: 1 to 2,560 (10 degrees).

party_damage_pct.description:
The percent of a player's damage that applies when 1, 2 or 3 players are present
(ADR-SIM-8): exactly 3 entries, each 1 to 100 (`MAX_PARTY_DAMAGE_PCT`), read at each hit.
Absent: `[100, 100, 100]`, so a pack published before the key existed still reads.

perfect_evade_cooldown_ticks.description:
Ticks before the evader's next perfect evade: from `perfect_evade_slow_ticks` to
`MAX_PERFECT_COOLDOWN_TICKS` (3,600).

perfect_evade_reach.description:
How near the evader an enemy's centre is slowed, in 1/256 px: 1 px to `MAX_PERFECT_REACH`
(420) px.

perfect_evade_slow_every.description:
A slowed enemy acts on the ticks where the slow's remaining ticks are a multiple of this:
2 to `MAX_PERFECT_SLOW_EVERY` (8).

perfect_evade_slow_ticks.description: Ticks the enemies in the evader's reach are slowed: 1 to `MAX_PERFECT_SLOW_TICKS` (300).

perfect_evade_window_ticks.description:
The perfect evade (`sim_version` 2; all five `perfect_evade_*` keys or none; absent: the
rule is off). Ticks after an effective evade press in which a hit the evade alone stops is
a near miss: 1 to `MAX_PERFECT_WINDOW_TICKS` (30).

player_radius.description: The main character's hurt circle, in 1/256 px: 1 to `limits::MAX_RADIUS`.

player_speed.description: The main character's speed at full stick, in 1/256 px a tick: 1 to 4,096.

poise_damage_a.description:
The poise damage of a main character's combo hit of an A (`main`) step when its phase
names none: 0 to `validate::limits::MAX_POISE_DAMAGE` (1,000). `sim_version` 2 only.
Absent: 0.

poise_damage_b.description: The same for a smash step (B): 0 to 1,000. `sim_version` 2 only. Absent: 0.

ranged_line_tokens.description: Tokens of the line attacks' pool: at least 1; the two pools sum to at most 4.

ranged_token_cooldown_ticks.description: Ticks a ranged token cools before its pool grants it again: 0 to 600.

ranged_zone_tokens.description: Tokens of the zone attacks' pool: at least 1; with the line pool at most the engine ceiling of 4 ranged attackers.

spawn_margin.description: How far outside the view an enemy spawns, in 1/256 px: 0 to 1,024 px.

stagger_damage_pct.description:
The percent a staggered elite or boss (and its parts) takes more damage: 1 to
`limits::MAX_PCT` (1,000). `sim_version` 2 only. Absent: none.

stagger_drain_delay_ticks.description:
Ticks after a fill before the gauge drains: 1 to `limits::MAX_STAGGER_DRAIN_TICKS` (600).
Only with `stagger_drain_per_tick`, `sim_version` 2 only. Absent: the gauge never drains.

stagger_drain_per_tick.description:
What an idle gauge loses each tick once the delay is over: 1 to `limits::MAX_STAGGER`.
Only with `stagger_drain_delay_ticks`.

stagger_refill_pcts.description:
What percent of its value a fill keeps by the number of bars already broken: 1 to
`limits::MAX_STAGGER_REFILLS` (8) entries of 1 to 100; past the last entry the last one
holds. `sim_version` 2 only. Absent: every bar fills at 100.

stagger_smash.description:
The stagger a main character's smash (B) step adds to the gauge of an elite or the boss
when its phase names none: 0 to `limits::MAX_STAGGER` (10,000). `sim_version` 2 only.
Absent: 0.

stagger_values.description:
What a control a smash puts on an elite or the boss, and that it resists, adds to the
gauge. `sim_version` 2 only. Absent: none adds.

staggered_ticks.description:
Ticks an elite or the boss stays staggered when its own definition names none: 1 to
`limits::MAX_STAGGERED_TICKS` (600). `sim_version` 2 only. Absent: each elite or boss that
names a `stagger_max` must name its own `staggered_ticks`.

vulnerable_pcts.description:
The `vulnerable` percent a landing control puts on its target, by kind of control.
`sim_version` 2 only. Absent: none.

RunLedger.description: A run's ledger of counts and bestiary encounters, verified with the replay (ADR-BRDG-6).

bestiary.description: Bestiary bits per enemy kind ID: bit 0 encountered, bits 1..=10 for `DamageType::ALL`.

picks.description: The stars the main character took, in pick order: the run's build.

skill_uses.description: Stage skill uses per stage skill ID.

checkpoints.description:
The FNV-1a 64 state hash after every 60th tick (60, 120, 180, ...), each taken right
after that tick and before the commands that follow it, each 16 lowercase hex digits,
concatenated: `16 * (ticks / 60)` digits, empty for fewer than 60 ticks.

commands.description:
Schema 1: the commands between ticks, packed as described in the module documentation.
Schema 2: the empty string; a pick is a field of the step it was made on.

content_sha256.description:
The SHA-256 of the game content the run used, lowercase hex: of the bytes of its content
pack (`content_sha256_with`, ADR-CONT-5). Any other pack invalidates the replay.

final_hash.description:
The FNV-1a 64 state hash after the last tick and the commands after it (ADR-SIM-3), 16
lowercase hex digits.
