inputs.description:
The inputs: at schema 1 the per-tick input stream packed as a stage replay's is; at
schema 2 the step log (`step_log`), then base64.

ticks.description: Ticks recorded, at most the mode's length (a `time_limit` run's: its length, overtime and the Star-Hunter's extra time). A run that ended ends on the tick it ended.

RunSetup.description:
What a run starts from: built by the app from local storage when a run starts, and stored
in the run's replay (ADR-REPL-5).

carried.description:
The stars the run starts holding, at most `MAX_CARRIED_STARS`: each
applies at tick 0 as if picked from an offer, in this order, and counts toward its
reward's stack limit. Their costs (the rewards file's `rarities`) add up to at most `lumine`.
None at `sim_version` 2.

difficulty.description:
The difficulty the run is played on, by the ID of the run's difficulties file:
it scales the enemies, bounds the rarities and may set the mode's length. A setup written
before difficulties existed reads as `DEFAULT_DIFFICULTY`, `normal`, which changes nothing.

drop_weights.description:
The player's extra drop weight in percent for each perk category of the run's rewards file
(the Star Chart, ADR-SAVE-17), by category ID: at most `MAX_EQUIP_CATEGORIES` keys, each at
most the category's `drop_weight_max`. It adds to the perk set's own `drop_weight` for the
category; a missing key adds 0. Only at `sim_version` 2; sorted by key, so the file's bytes
are stable.

extra_rerolls.description:
Rerolls the player's progress adds to the stage's, at most `MAX_EXTRA_REROLLS`. None at
`sim_version` 2.

lumine.description:
The level of the Lumine upgrade, at most `MAX_LUMINE`: at `sim_version` 2 the cap of the
Lumine star's rarity (ADR-SAVE-7 point 9), at 1 the budget of `carried`.

lumine_star.description:
The one star of the Lumine slot (ADR-SAVE-7 points 3 and 4): a reward ID of the run's
rewards file, never a rune; it starts equipped at Lv1 at tick 0, in
the build from the first tick, and then changes like any other slot (equip rules, kills,
replace, extract). Its rarity is capped by `lumine`. Only at `sim_version` 2.

mode.description: A mode ID: the content the run plays.

perk_set.description:
The perk set the run applies from tick 0, by the ID of the run's perk
sets file. A setup written before perk sets existed reads as `DEFAULT_PERK_SET`.

rune_pool.description:
The runes the random rune may draw: rune IDs, sorted, each
once, at most `MAX_RUNE_POOL`. Empty: every rune.

seed.description: Seeds the run's SplitMix64 (ADR-SIM-2), all 64 bits.

star_pool.description:
The pool of offers mode (ADR-SAVE-7 point 2), by the IDs of the run's rewards file: the
rewards an offer may hold at `sim_version` 1; each at most once. Absent: every reward in
the file. None at `sim_version` 2: every star of the pack drops and is craftable, and the
Lumine star is any star the level allows.

starting_rune.description:
A rune the run starts holding: in the rune pool when there is one. It
costs no Lumine, and the random rune never draws it again.

stat_priority.description:
The run stats a level-up is spent on, most wanted first (DS18): run stat IDs, each once,
at most `MAX_RUN_STATS`. Each level reached raises the first of them below its limit,
then the stats this list leaves out in the run stats file's order; empty is that order
alone.

unlocked_styles.description:
The styles of `weapon` the player has unlocked (ADR-SIM-9 point 8, ADR-SAVE-7 point 10),
by the style's ID in the run's expertise file: sorted, each once, at most
`MAX_UNLOCKED_STYLES`, only at `sim_version` 2. Absent: every style is offered. Present:
only the listed styles are offered, in the expertise file's order; an empty list offers
no style pick and the run plays the plain base.

upgrades.description:
The permanent upgrades the player holds (ADR-REPL-5): registered upgrade IDs, sorted, each
once, at most `registry::MAX_UPGRADES`. They open no combo step any more (every smash is
open, ADR-REPL-5): an old setup that names `giant_sword_aab` and the others still reads, and
they are ignored.

weapon.description: A weapon preset: the one weapon the run's main character carries.

weapon_tree.description:
Which of the weapon's base trees the run uses (ADR-REPL-5), by the tree's ID: it sets the
combo tree's steps and the smash effect, and is fixed for the run. Absent: the weapon's
first tree, so a setup written before trees existed reads as it always did. The weapon's
styles are not trees: `unlocked_styles` names the ones the run may pick.

RunStat.description: One stat a point can raise.

id.description: The stat's own ID, unique within the file.

limit.description: The most points the stat takes in a run, from 1 to `MAX_LIMIT`.

step.description: What one point adds, from 1 to `MAX_STEP` (`MAX_HP_STEP` for hit points).

enemy_attack_damage.description:
The damage an enemy's or the boss's attack does when it names none, in stored hit points,
1 to `MAX_PLAYER_HP`; absent, `DEFAULT_ENEMY_ATTACK_DAMAGE`.

max_attack_speed_pct.description:
The most the attack speed total reaches, in percent, 1 to `MAX_ATTACK_SPEED_PCT`
(app#298); absent, `DEFAULT_MAX_ATTACK_SPEED_PCT`.

stats.description: The stats, in the order a stat offer lists them and the setup's priority falls back on.

RunVerified.description: What a successful verification proves: the run as recorded reaches this tick and hash.

commands.description: The commands between ticks that applied.

ledger.description: The ledger of counts, bestiary encounters and build picks (ADR-BRDG-6).

outcome.description: How the run stood at the end: a bug report may stop while it is still running.

stardust.description:
The Stardust the run earned, times 10, at most `limits::MAX_RUN_STARDUST`: the
app pays it after the run (ADR-REPL-5).

Rune.description: A rune, one of the closed list.

oneOf.description: On-hit: an explosion around the point a combo step hits.
On-hit: a strike called down on the point a combo step hits, after a wind-up.
On-hit: thrown from the main character to the point a combo step hits, and back.

On-hit: missiles launched from the main character that steer to aim assist's targets,
each hitting once.

Damage over time: a combo step's hit puts the `bleed` status on the enemy hit, or a stack
more of it.

Damage over time: a combo step's hit puts the `poison` status, Dendro, on the enemy hit,
or a stack more of it.

Damage over time: a combo step's hit puts the `burn` status, Pyro, on the enemy hit, or
a stack more of it.

RuneView.description: A rune the Main weapon holds.

cooldown_left.description: For an on-hit rune, ticks until it may fire again; 0 for a damage-over-time rune.

damage_over_time.description: Every damage-over-time rune's numbers, each rune once.

on_hit.description: Every on-hit rune's numbers, each rune once.

Selector.description:
Who a rule, condition or skill acts on. Ties break by squared fixed-point distance, then
entity ID (ADR-SIM-4).

oneOf.description: A boss part, by the part ID the stage gives it.

SetStat.description:
One stat of a weapon base set or a style set (the equipment build): its value at weapon level
1 to 10.

by_level.description:
Exactly `TABLE_LEVELS` entries, Lv1 to Lv10, never falling. Tenths of a percent, except
`max_hp`: hit points in the stored scale of every other `max_hp` amount.

effect.description:
One of `attack_pct`, `attack_speed_pct`, `evade_pct`, `skill_cooldown_pct`, `range_pct`
and `max_hp`, once per set.

ticks_left.description: Ticks it still holds, this one included.

Side.description: A side of the spawn rectangle, or all of it.

Skill.description: A skill block (ADR-SIM-4). Percentages are whole percent.

SkillEffect.description: One building block of a use, at the skill's point.

oneOf.description:
For `duration_ticks`, every enemy whose circle reaches within `radius` of the point is
pulled `strength` toward it each tick, after the enemies have moved, and so held there.
The boss and its parts are not pulled. A new pull replaces the one still pulling.

radius.description: A length in 1/256 pixel units. In files it is the plain integer.

strength.description: A length in 1/256 pixel units. In files it is the plain integer.

oneOf.description:
`status` (a status ID of the registry, ADR-SIM-4) on the main character, `value_pct`
percent, for `duration_ticks`.

`status` on every enemy, the boss and its parts included, whose circle reaches within
`radius` of the point, `value_pct` percent, for `duration_ticks`.

radius.description: A length in 1/256 pixel units. In files it is the plain integer.

oneOf.description:
`attack` runs in the stage skill's own attack slot, along the aim, at the main
character's attack stat: it neither waits for nor cancels a combo step. A new attack
ends the one still running.

Absorbs up to `amount` damage to the main character for `duration_ticks`. A new shield
replaces the one held.

SkillLevel.description: One level of a stage skill.

cooldown_ticks.description: Ticks after a use before it is ready again, from 1 to `MAX_SKILL_COOLDOWN_TICKS`.

effects.description:
What a use does, in this order: 1 to `MAX_SKILL_EFFECTS` effects, at most one of each
block.

SkillView.description: The stage skill held: what the skill button draws.

cooldown_left.description: Ticks until it is ready again, counted from its use.

ready.description: A press on the next tick would use it.

skill.description: Its ID in the stage skills file, for its name.

oneOf.description: A category slot: the category's index in the layout.
The Lumine slot, present only when the run's setup names a Lumine star.

SlotView.description:
One equipment slot: what it holds, its level (0 while it never held anything) and the kills
toward its next level.

SmashEffect.description:
What a smash (a step reached by `smash`) does to every enemy it hits: one
of a closed list built into `core`, its numbers in JSON (ADR-CONT-1).

oneOf.description:
The enemy hit is drawn toward the main character, at most `distance`, over `ticks`, and
stops where their circles touch. A boss, its parts and elites resist it.

distance.description: A length in 1/256 pixel units. In files it is the plain integer.

oneOf.description:
The enemy hit is pushed away from the main character, at most `distance`, over `ticks`,
and stays inside the map. A boss, its parts and elites resist it, as they resist the pull.

distance.description: A length in 1/256 pixel units. In files it is the plain integer.

oneOf.description:
The enemy hit gets the `bleed` status, the one bleed with the bleed rune's
numbers from the run's runes file, none of its own. A run whose file has
no bleed gives none.

The enemy hit is stunned for `ticks`: it stops what it was doing and cannot act
until the stun runs out. Bosses resist it, and an elite takes half the ticks.

A smash hit adds a bleed stack, as `bleed` does; a smash that hits an enemy holding
`stacks` bleed stacks cashes them instead: the stacks go and the enemy takes the bleed's
remaining damage at once. A boss and its parts take `boss_pct` percent of it. Needs
`sim_version` 2 (ADR-SIM-9).

SmashEffectKind.description: Which smash effect a `smash_effect` kind sets, by name only.

constellations.description:
The run's constellations and how many of each set's members are held (core#NS3); empty
without sets or without stars.

entities.description: Companions, enemies, the boss and its parts, in entity-ID order.

expertise.description:
The expertise gauge; absent in a stage whose enemies and boss give no
expertise points.

heal_pickups.description: Heal pickups on the map, in the order they dropped; empty without healing.

map.description: The map's size, so the frontend can bound its camera (core#87).

patterns.description:
The boss's big patterns announced and not yet started, the call of its elites
first; the frontend draws each as a count-down bar.

players.description: One per active player, indexed by `PlayerIdx`; a run of one has one.

progress.description: Experience, level, stat points; absent in a stage without levels.

stardust.description:
The Stardust earned so far, times 10; absent in a stage without a Stardust
factor.

starlight.description:
What Starlight costs and gives, the same for every player; absent in a stage run alone and at
`sim_version` 1.

stars.description: Falling stars on the map, in the order they dropped (ADR-REPL-5).

zones.description:
Zones placed and not yet over, in the order they were placed (core Z1); the frontend draws
each as a telegraph while it warns and as a hit while it is active.

SpiritEffect.description:
What a spirit level does: a closed list built into `core`, one variant per effect, each
bounded alone.

oneOf.description: Added to the attack-up percent fixed when a combo step starts. 1 to `MAX_PCT`.

Added to the step's range percent, the total held to `MAX_RANGE_PCT`. 1 to
`MAX_RANGE_PCT`.

Bleed stacks added to a smash hit on top of the one the smash's own effect adds; needs a
bleed smash. 1 to `MAX_SPIRIT_BLEED_STACKS`.

SpiritView.description:
A player's spirit level (ADR-SIM-9): not state, built each frame from the level, the countdown
and the style's numbers.

decay_left.description: Ticks until the level drops; 0 at level 0, where nothing counts.

crowd_target.description:
The crowd target of the run (DIR1, DS103): the pack's `rules.json` gives the default
(200), this overrides it, 1 to `MAX_CROWD_TARGET`. The run's enemy cap derives from it
and is never stored; a target whose cap would pass the engine ceiling is clamped when
the run is built. A stage's waves keep their authored timing: only a horde run holds
its waves at the target.

elite_cap.description:
The most elites alive at once; `MAX_ELITES_ALIVE` when absent. An elite that
would spawn past it does not, and a wave counts it as spawned.

heal.description:
Healing: what a boss kill heals and the heal pickups a regular kill may drop. Without it
a stage heals only by a reward.

id.description: The stage ID: the file name and the first half of the version tag.

length_ticks.description: Ticks until the stage ends if the boss is still alive.

level_table.description: The levels of the expertise style path; `LevelTable::NORMAL` when absent.

levels.description:
Experience and levels, each level-up giving a stat point (ADR-REPL-5); a mode's stages
have them. Without them defeated enemies give nothing.

map.description: The map the run plays on; without one, the portrait field (`Map::PORTRAIT`).

schema_version.description: `crate::version::SCHEMA_VERSION` when the game wrote the file.

seed.description:
Seeds the run's SplitMix64 (ADR-SIM-2). 32 bits so that every tool reading the file as
JSON, GDScript included, keeps it exact; the simulation widens it.

sim_version.description: `crate::version::SIM_VERSION` when the game wrote the file.

stardust.description: How a kill's Stardust grows over the run: without it the run counts none.

stars.description:
Falling stars and the offers they open (ADR-REPL-5); only with `levels`.
Without them kills drop nothing and nothing is offered.

try_styles.description:
Under it each tree point of the level table is a style pick again, recorded as a
`TreePick` (ADR-SIM-9 point 8); absent and `false` are the same. `sim_version` 2. Only
the tutorial mode takes it: the run builder drops it from every other mode.

ahead.description:
How far ahead of the main character its point is, along the facing, or toward the aim
assist's target while `assist` is on; 0, the default, is at the main
character. An attack places its own hit boxes instead.

icon.description: The asset the skill button draws (ADR-CONT-2): an asset ID of the registry.

id.description: The skill's own ID, unique within the file; a reward names it.

stage_skills.description: The skills, at most `MAX_STAGE_SKILLS`; a skill's place here is what the slot holds.

StaggerValues.description:
What a resisted control adds to a stagger gauge, by kind of control (each 1 to
`limits::MAX_STAGGER`); a kind left out adds nothing. The other controls add their own key later.

counter.description:
What a counter adds to the gauge of an elite or the boss it countered. Read at
`sim_version` 2; absent: a counter adds nothing.

knockdown.description:
What a knockback adds on top of its own value when an elite, the boss or a part resists it
(a knockback that would have knocked a regular enemy down). Only with `down_ticks`.

stun.description: A smash's stun on an elite or the boss.

StarChartFile.description: The star chart file: what the chart sells and at what price.

expertise_levels.description: The number of levels the expertise multiplier has, from 1 to `MAX_LEVELS`.

expertise_multiplier.description:
The expertise multiplier's price per level: exactly `expertise_levels` prices, never
falling.

lumine_levels.description: The Lumine levels' price per level: exactly `MAX_LUMINE` prices, never falling.

perk_sets.description: Perk sets for sale, at most `MAX_ITEMS`.

stage_skills.description: Stage skills for sale, at most `MAX_ITEMS`.

starting_rune.description:
The price of the unlock that lets a player carry a starting rune, from 1 to `MAX_PRICE`.
The runes themselves are unlocked by Rune Shards, so none is priced here.

stats.description: Run stats for sale, at most `MAX_ITEMS`.

styles.description: The styles each weapon sells, at most `MAX_ITEMS` weapons. Absent when none is priced.

weapons.description: Weapon presets for sale, at most `MAX_ITEMS`.

StarPick.description: A star in the run's build (core#NS3).

StarView.description: A falling star waiting on the map to be taken.

StardustFactor.description:
The Stardust time factor: a table of time tiers, each the tick it starts
at and a percent. A kill's base Stardust is multiplied by the percent of the last tier that
started at or before the kill tick, truncated toward zero; past the last tier's start
(overtime included) the last tier holds. A mode's run takes the mode file's table, or its
difficulty's when the difficulty gives one. `stardust_tiers_problem`
says what a valid table is.

summon_base.description:
The base Stardust a kill of a summoned enemy earns before the factor, times 10 (a boss's
or a splitter's `summon`), at most `limits::MAX_STARDUST_BASE`; none when absent.
Guardians, escorts and a boss's parts earn nothing.

tiers.description: 1 to `limits::MAX_STARDUST_TIERS` tiers, the first at tick 0, the ticks rising strictly.

StardustFile.description: The Stardust file: one entry per mode.

modes.description: At most `MAX_MODES` entries, one per mode.

StardustTier.description:
One tier of the Stardust time factor: from `start_tick` until the next tier starts, a kill
earns `pct` percent of its base.

start_tick.description: When the tier starts, in ticks from the start of the run.

StarlightPrice.description: What extracting a star of a rarity gives and what crafting one costs, in Starlight.

StarlightView.description: The Starlight prices of an equipment run (placeholders until the pack carries them).

boss_bonus.description: What each player who is up gets from a boss kill.

rune_extract.description: What an extracted rune gives: a rune has no rarity.

Stars.description: How kills drop falling stars, what rarity a star has, and what an offer allows.

cap.description:
The most stars on the map at once. A kill with the map full drops none, and does not
count toward the pity.

drop_per_mille.description: The chance, in 1000, that a kill drops a star.

pickup_radius.description: How near the main character's centre a star must come to be taken.

pity.description: Kills in a row without a star after which the next kill drops one for sure.

rerolls.description: Rerolls of one candidate a run gets, before the setup's extra rerolls.

tiers.description:
The drop table: tiers by the player's level, the first from level 1, each later one from
a higher level. A star draws its rarity from the tier of the level reached.

StartingUnlocksFile.description: The starting unlocks file: the IDs a new save begins with, by kind.

free_perk_set.description:
The perk set every save may use without owning it: a perk set of the pack's perk sets
file.

free_weapon.description:
The weapon preset every save may play without owning it: a weapon of the pack's
weapons file.

perk_sets.description: Perk sets of the pack's perk sets file.

runes.description: Runes of the pack's runes file.

stage_skills.description: Stage skills of the pack's stage skills file.

StatEffect.description:
What a point in a stat does, `step` times over. The closed list of effects;
percentages add up over every stat with the same effect and round down.

oneOf.description: `step` more hit points at most, and as many healed.
`step` percent more damage from every attack of the main character.

`step` percent faster attacks: a combo step's length divided by `1 + step / 100`
each of its phases at least 1 tick.
A `step` percent shorter evade cooldown (at least 1 tick).
`step` percent more movement speed.

`step` percent more experience from every kill, rounded down (the build that
unlocks rarer stars sooner).

Rerolls of an offer. Written in equipment mode only (a Growth star and the perk's extra
rerolls); nothing reads the total yet except as a run stat.

Banishes of an offer. Written in equipment mode only; nothing reads the total yet
except as a run stat.

Candidates an offer holds beyond its size. Written in equipment mode only; nothing
reads the total yet except as a run stat.
`step` percent more pickup radius, added to the player's own percentage.
`step` percent more Stardust earned, truncated once with the stage's time factor.

`step` percent shorter stage-skill cooldown, added to the skill-cooldown reward's percent;
the sum is held to `MAX_SKILL_COOLDOWN_TOTAL_PCT`.

`step` percent wider combo hit boxes, added to the range reward's and the expertise range;
the sum is held to `MAX_RANGE_PCT`.

StatPrices.description: A run stat sold level by level.

id.description: A stat of the pack's run stats, once in the list.

prices.description:
The price of each level in tenths of Stardust: level n costs `prices[n - 1]`. Exactly as
many prices as the stat's `limit` in the pack's run stats (at most `MAX_STAT_LEVELS`), each
from 1 to `MAX_PRICE`, never falling.

StatValueView.description:
One stat of a set. Percentages are in **tenths of a percent** (165 is 16.5 percent); the
most hit points (`MaxHp`) are whole units.

next.description: The value at the next level (the same at level 10).

now.description: The value at the weapon's level.

StatusView.description:
A status on an entity, or a pack leader's aura: what the app shows as
an icon with a count-down, or as a row while it lasts.

id.description:
The status's content ID: `atk_up`, `vulnerable`, `slow`, `flinch`, `knocked_down`, `staggered`, `bleed`, `poison`, `burn`, or
`aura` for a pack leader's aura, which has no content ID of its own.

remaining.description:
Ticks left. An aura has none: it lasts while its entity is in reach, so both this and
`total` are 0 for it.

total.description: The ticks the status was applied for, or 0 for an aura.

attack.description: The step's own attack: what a tap makes, and level 0 of a charge.

charge.description: While the button that reached the step stays held as it starts, it charges instead.

hold.description:
Held past its last `active` phase, the button that reached the step starts a hold
instead of the attack's recovery. A step has a charge or a hold, never
both.

big.description:
A big pattern: announced in the snapshot, with the ticks left until it
starts, while the timed steps before it run. Only a preset can be big; its ID names
it.

oneOf.description: Starts the timeline again from its first step.

StepGrant.description: A grant on a step of the base tree: a charge or a hold, never both (ADR-SIM-9 point 3).

oneOf.description: The step charges while its button stays held as it starts.
The step holds past its last active phase.

StepGrantKind.description: Which a `replace_step` grant gives its step.

StunRules.description:
The stun rules: run rules read with the stats, as they are content
too. Both are tuning values; that each is bounded is the decision.

elite_pct.description: The share of a stun's ticks an elite takes, in percent, 0 to 100.

immune_ticks.description:
Ticks after a stun ends in which the enemy cannot be stunned again, 0 to
`MAX_STUN_IMMUNE_TICKS`.

Style.description:
A style: a path chosen at the level table's style level, held for the run. Its
own effect applies when it is chosen at `sim_version` 1 (a version 2 run applies the style's
`stats` set instead: the set is everything); it then offers the fixed choices of `upgrade_1` at the
table's first upgrade level, `upgrade_2` at the second and `capstone` at the capstone's.

amount.description:
What choosing it adds to the effect's total, from 1 to the effect's most; absent (0) for
the effect `none`.

id.description: The style's own ID, unique within its weapon.

kinds.description:
The mechanic kinds the style pick grants, at most `MAX_LEVEL_KINDS`; absent or empty for
none (`sim_version` 2).

stats.description:
The set the style grants in the equipment build, replacing the weapon's base set when
the style is picked: at most `MAX_SET_STATS` stats. Absent or empty: the empty set.

StyleKind.description:
A mechanic a style level grants: a closed list built into `core`, its numbers in JSON
(ADR-SIM-9 point 3, ADR-CONT-1). Every kind is bounded and validated alone and against the
weapon's base tree. Only the kinds that are listed exist.

oneOf.description:
The step reached by `step` (the presses from the root of the combo tree, 1 to
`MAX_COMBO_DEPTH` long: `[main, main, main]` is AAA, `[smash]` is B from neutral) gets
`grant`. A grant sets the step's charge (clearing its hold) or its hold (clearing its
charge), so a step never ends with both; two grants on one step inside one style are
refused.

The weapon's smash effect (every smash, the dash branch's too) is `effect` in place of the
base's (ADR-SIM-9 point 4). One per style path: a second is refused.

The step reached by `step` repeats: `after_ticks` after its last `active` phase ends,
`repeat_pct` percent of its damage lands again on `anchor`, firing ready on-hit runes at
`proc_pct` (absent: every ready rune, no draw). Not on a held step; at most
`MAX_STEP_REPEATS` per step over one style's path.

Each hit of the step reached by `step` fires a ready on-hit rune only when a draw falls
under `proc_pct` (0 to `MAX_PROC_PCT`); one per step per style.

The style's weapon gauge: it fills from the player's normal (A) steps that hit and from the
hit points lost, and a B press with it full plays the full-gauge attack and empties it
(ADR-SIM-9 points 3 and 7). One per style path: a second is refused.

from_damage_pct.description:
A hit taken adds `max * lost * pct / (max_hp * 100)` (floor), `lost` the hit points really
lost; absent (0): no rule. At most `MAX_GAUGE_DAMAGE_PCT`.

max.description: The gauge never passes it; full is `max` reached. 1 to `MAX_WEAPON_GAUGE`.

per_hit.description:
Added for each enemy a normal step's hit box hits on a tick; absent (0): no rule. At most
`max`.

per_step.description:
Added once to a normal step the first time one of its hit boxes hits an enemy; absent
(0): no rule. At most `max`.

step_cap.description:
The most one step's hits add (the bound on a horde, ADR-SIM-5): 1 to `max`. The damage
fill is not held to it.

oneOf.description:
The style's spirit level, 0 to `levels.len()`: a full-gauge smash raises it by one, every
smash restarts a countdown of `decay_ticks`, and the level drops by one when it runs out;
each level carries its own effects (ADR-SIM-9 points 2 to 7). The style also names a gauge
whose spend is `full_smash`. One per style path: a second is refused.

decay_ticks.description: Ticks a level lasts without a smash. 1 to `MAX_SPIRIT_DECAY_TICKS`.

levels.description:
Entry `i` is level `i + 1`'s effects, its own and no running sum; the length is the
style's top level, 1 to `MAX_SPIRIT_LEVEL`. An empty entry is a level with no effect, and
a level names each effect at most once.

StyleKindView.description:
A mechanic kind a style level grants, in the compact form a snapshot carries (built every
frame, so the grant's attacks are not inside).

oneOf.description: The step the presses reach from the root of the combo tree gets a charge or a hold.
The weapon's smash effect is this one in place of the base's.
The step repeats after `after_ticks`, `repeat_pct` percent of its damage, on `anchor`.
Each hit of the step fires a ready on-hit rune only at `proc_pct` percent.
The style has a weapon gauge `max` long, spent as `spend`.
The style has a spirit level, 0 to `max_level`, that falls `decay_ticks` after a smash.

ThreatColour.description:
One colour of the table: an ID and its RGB value, 0 to 255 each. Alpha and brightness are
the frontend's. The ID is lowercase snake_case, unique in the file, and never renamed or
removed once released (ADR-CONT-2): the frontend remaps by it.

ThreatColourIndex.description:
The index of an entry in the run's threat colour table. It is only meaningful with that
run's table: key anything that outlives the run on the ID.

colours.description: At most `MAX_THREAT_COLOURS` entries; an empty list is valid.

Tier.description: One tier of the drop table.

from_level.description: The level the tier starts at.

random_rune_weight.description:
The draw weight of the `random_rune` reward among its rarity while this tier applies, from
1 to `MAX_WEIGHT`; left out, the reward's own `weight`.

bosses.description:
The boss definitions (core#336), 0 to `MAX_BOSS_DEFINITIONS`, each for one sprite: a
pool entry or the final boss with a definition here is made from it, one without is made
from the trial's placeholder boss with its sprite. Each is checked as a stage's boss is,
when a run starts (`run_setup`), and its sprite is an asset.

crowd_target.description:
The crowd target of the mode's runs (DIR1, DS103): the pack's `rules.json` gives the
default (200), this overrides it, 1 to `MAX_CROWD_TARGET`. The run's stage takes it as its
own, and the director holds the mode's wave spawns at it.

elite_cap.description:
The most elites alive at once, 1 to `MAX_ELITES_ALIVE` (the stage's `elite_cap` has the
same bound). The run's stage takes it as its own.

elite_table.description:
The elites each whole minute that starts no boss brings: 1 to
`MAX_ELITE_TIERS` time tiers, the first at tick 0, the rest rising strictly and starting
before the length. An elite minute draws from it (`sim::horde`).

elite_types.description:
The elite types: 1 to `MAX_ELITE_DEFINITIONS`, each with a unique ID. The
table names them; one no tier names is allowed.

id.description: The mode's ID, `time_limit`.

length_ticks.description: The run's length in ticks, 1 to `MAX_LENGTH_TICKS`.

level_table.description:
The expertise levels of the style path: the style first, the levels rising
strictly, two upgrades and a capstone, each from 1 to `stage::MAX_STYLE_LEVEL`. The
run's stage takes it as its own.

levels.description:
The experience curve of the run (XP2): the experience each next level needs, as a
stage's `levels` (1 to `limits::MAX_LEVELS` entries, each 1 to `limits::MAX_LEVEL_XP`),
the last repeating. Not `level_table`, which is the style path's expertise. The run's
stage takes it as its own.

mid_boss_hp_pct.description:
The mid-bosses' hit points by slot, in percent (core#336): entry k scales the k-th
mid-boss's hit points and its parts', before the difficulty does; a slot past the list
is at 100. At most `MAX_BOSS_TIMES` entries of 1 to `difficulties::MAX_PCT`. The final
boss is never scaled by it.

mid_boss_pool.description:
The bosses a mid-boss is drawn from (sprite IDs): at least one for each mid-boss time,
at most `MAX_POOL`.

no_call_ticks.description:
The boss times at which no elite is called (core#336), each once, at most
`MAX_BOSS_TIMES`. A time that is no boss time of the run has no effect; every other boss calls its elites as its definition says.

overtime_ticks.description:
How long the run goes on past the length while the final boss lives, in ticks, 1 to
`MAX_OVERTIME_TICKS`.

star_hunter_extra_ticks.description:
The time the Star-Hunter adds, in ticks, 1 to `MAX_EXTRA_TICKS`. Read and checked now;
a later step uses it.

stardust_summon_base.description:
The base Stardust a kill of a summoned enemy earns before the factor, times 10, at most
`limits::MAX_STARDUST_BASE`; the run's stage takes it as its `stardust.summon_base`.

stardust_tiers.description:
The Stardust time factor: 1 to `limits::MAX_STARDUST_TIERS` tiers,
the first at tick 0, the ticks rising strictly, each percent from 1 to
`limits::MAX_STARDUST_PCT`. A run takes it unless its difficulty gives its own.

stars.description:
The falling stars' drop table of the run (XP2), as a stage's `stars`, checked the same
way; its tiers follow `levels`. The run's stage takes it as its own.

waves.description:
The enemies that spawn over the run, 0 to `MAX_WAVES` waves of up to `MAX_SPAWN_COUNT`
enemies, `MAX_TOTAL_SPAWNS` in all, none an elite, each starting before the length. A
wave with `edge` spawns on the spawn rectangle around the main character (VS1); the
placeholder content is the trial's enemies.

TimeLimitMap.description: An open field: its sides in 1/256 pixels and where the player starts.

oneOf.description: Removes every enemy zone, as `clear_orbs` removes every enemy orb (core Z1).

TreeReadyView.description:
A weapon tree point a player holds in the equipment build (ADR-SIM-7): nothing is opened and
the world is not stopped; the player takes it with `TreePick`, whose `option` indexes `options`.

kind.description: Style, Upgrade or Capstone: the next pick's kind.

kinds.description:
The mechanic kinds each option grants, one entry per option in `options` order; absent
while no option names a kind.

level.description: The level table's level of this pick.

options.description: The choices, in the order `TreePick.option` indexes.

grants.description:
What the style grants besides stats: its own level, then its three path levels; absent
when no level names a kind.

stats.description: The stats it gives at the weapon's level.

TypeBonusView.description:
The type bonus the main character holds for one damage type: the one-type
bonuses of that type and its group's bonus, added up.

ViewEdge.description:
Where on the spawn rectangle around the main character a wave spawns (VS1): the rectangle is
±484 by ±244 px, the camera's view (±420 by ±180 px, kept inside the map) and a margin of
64 px. Only its part on the map
is used; a side wholly off the map gives way to the opposite one.

along.description:
Per mille of the half side from its middle, -1000 (the left or top end) to 1000 (the right
or bottom end): every enemy spawns at that point of the side. Absent, the point is drawn
along the side. Not with the side `any`.

side.description: The side, or `any` for the whole rectangle.

VulnerablePcts.description:
What a control adds to the target's damage taken as `vulnerable`, in percent, by the kind of
control that landed. Only the stun for now; the other controls add their own key later.

knockdown.description:
A knockdown puts `vulnerable` of this many percent on the downed enemy for the knockdown's
own ticks: 1 to `limits::MAX_PCT` (1,000). Only with `down_ticks`. Absent: none.

stagger.description:
A stagger puts `vulnerable` of this many percent on the staggered elite or boss for the
stagger's own ticks: 1 to `limits::MAX_PCT` (1,000). Absent: a stagger puts none.

stun.description:
A stun that lands puts `vulnerable` of this many percent on its target for the stun's
own ticks: 1 to `limits::MAX_PCT` (1,000). Absent: a stun puts none.

Wave.description: `count` copies of `enemy`, the first at `at_tick`, then one every `every_ticks`.

edge.description:
A side of the view: each enemy of the wave spawns on the spawn rectangle, 64 px outside
the view (840 by 360 px, the camera's, kept inside the map), on the part of it that is on
the map (VS1, DS109).
Give this or `spawn`, not both.

expertise.description: The expertise points each enemy of the wave gives; none when absent.

id.description:
The wave's role in a `time_limit` schedule (R2): lowercase snake_case, unique among the
schedule's waves. A stage's waves do not use it; absent, the wave has no ID.

spawn.description:
A point on the map where each enemy of the wave spawns (a stage's way to place a wave).
Give this or `edge`, not both.

stardust.description:
The Stardust a kill of each enemy of the wave earns before the time factor, times 10
at most `limits::MAX_STARDUST_BASE`; none when absent. Counts only in a stage
with a `stardust` factor.

xp.description:
The experience each enemy of the wave gives when defeated, in a stage with `levels`;
1 when absent.

Weapon.description: A weapon: its combo tree, the timings that join its steps and its smash effect.

assist_range.description:
How far aim assist and auto mode look for a target: an enemy whose circle
reaches within this distance of the main character.

combo.description: The first step for each press, from the root.

dash.description:
The first step for each press during an evade's dash or within `dash_strike_ticks` after
it: the dash-strike. A press with no step here starts from `combo`.

dash_strike_ticks.description: Ticks after an evade's dash ends in which a press still takes the dash branch.

smash.description:
What every hit of a smash (a step reached by `smash`) adds, in the dash branch too; none
when absent.

window_ticks.description:
Ticks the combo keeps its place after a step's recovery has run out with no press
buffered; a press within them takes the next step, after them it starts from the root.

id.description: A registered weapon ID, unique within the file.

trees.description: The trees: exactly `MAX_TREES`, the base tree.

base.description:
The set the weapon grants in the equipment build until a style is picked: at most
`MAX_SET_STATS` stats. Absent or empty: the empty set.

common.description: The common pool, 1 to `MAX_COMMON_OPTIONS` options, in the order offers draw from.

styles.description: Exactly `STYLES` styles, in the order the style offer shows them.

weapon.description: A weapon preset of the registry.

WeaponIds.description:
The IDs one weapon's expertise introduces: its styles', their choices' and its common
options', at most `MAX_EXPERTISE_IDS`.

WeaponRef.description: A weapon preset by ID, or an inline weapon.

oneOf.description: A preset, in one of its trees (ADR-REPL-5): none is the weapon's first tree.

WeaponStatsView.description:
A weapon's stat sets as the weapon level `level` gives them (equipment mode), for the tree
selection window and the weapon window.

active.description: The tree chosen, by its style ID; absent before the style pick.

base.description: The base set: in force until a tree is chosen.

level.description: The weapon level, 1 to 10 (level 0 shows 1, and levels past 10 show 10).

trees.description: Every tree's set, in the weapon's style order (the order `TreeReadyView.options` lists).

WeaponStylePrices.description: The styles of one weapon the chart sells (ADR-SIM-9 point 8, ADR-SAVE-7 point 10).

styles.description:
Styles of that weapon in the pack's expertise file, at most `MAX_UNLOCKED_STYLES`, each
once, with its price in tenths of Stardust. A style left out has no price and is not for
sale.

weapon.description: A weapon of the pack, once in the list.

id.description:
The tree's own ID, unique within its weapon: lowercase snake_case, `<weapon>_base` for
tree 1 by convention.

ZoneShape.description: The area of a zone (core Z1), laid out like a hit box but placed by its emitter node.

radius.description: A length in 1/256 pixel units. In files it is the plain integer.

oneOf.description: A circle sector centred on the zone's direction, `half_angle` to each side.

radius.description: A length in 1/256 pixel units. In files it is the plain integer.

oneOf.description: A rectangle from the zone's centre along its direction.

length.description: A length in 1/256 pixel units. In files it is the plain integer.

width.description: A length in 1/256 pixel units. In files it is the plain integer.

ZoneView.description:
A zone (core Z1): where it is, which way an arc or a line points, and how long its current
phase has left. It does not move.

at.description: The centre of a circle or an arc, the starting end of a line.

friendly.description: Placed by the main character or a companion, rather than an enemy.

phase.description: `wind_up` while it warns, `active` while it hurts.

threat_colour.description:
The entry of the run's threat colour table (`Engine::threat_colours`) the enemy that
placed it names; absent for every other area, and for an enemy that names none: the
frontend draws its own hostile colour. Never present on a friendly area. Absent is the
key missing from the JSON.

ticks.description:
The length of that phase in ticks, at least `ticks_left`: what a wind-up's fill is drawn
against.

ticks_left.description: Ticks left of that phase, at least 1.

warn_only.description: A warning only: `phase` stays `wind_up` for its whole life and no hit follows.
